description: <p><strong>Graduate Fire Engineer 2027 Start – Belfast</strong></p> <p><strong>Company Overview</strong></p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we’ve been helping make our world safe, secure and resilient since 1939. If you are open to more than one location, we will discuss this with you during the recruitment process.</p> <p><strong><em>Please note: to be considered for this role, you must have the right to work in the UK or Ireland.</em></strong></p> <p><strong>Why join Jensen Hughes and grow your career?</strong></p> <p><strong>Your career can go further than you think.</strong> 74% of our current Directors and Technical Directors in the UK & Ireland started their careers with us as graduates.</p> <p><strong>Be part of a leading fire consultancy.</strong> We have offices across Belgium, Finland, Italy, Denmark and the UK & Ireland. Our reputation for innovative, design-focused solutions has made us the consultant of choice for many of Europe’s leading property clients.</p> <p><strong>Learn from experienced engineers.</strong> As a Graduate Fire Engineer, you will be an integral part of a dynamic design team. Working alongside experienced Engineers, you will receive ongoing technical support to build your knowledge and experience across fire engineering projects.</p> <p><strong>Build your career in a supportive environment.</strong> You’ll have the opportunity to develop your career within a supportive and diverse team where we strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.</p> <p><strong>Take responsibility early.</strong> You will be given early responsibility and the opportunity to progress rapidly. Jensen Hughes encourages all Engineers to work towards chartered status through the Institute of Fire Engineers, providing help and support throughout the process.</p> <p><strong>What will you be working on?</strong></p> <p>As a Graduate Fire Engineer, you’ll work on a variety of exciting projects, helping to develop innovative fire engineering solutions for new and existing buildings.</p> <p>Your work will include:</p> <ul> <li>Carrying out fire engineering analysis on a<br>range of new and existing building projects.</li> <li>Working across a diverse range of buildings,<br>including high-rise office buildings, large retail complexes and airport<br>developments, each presenting its own unique challenges.</li> <li>Analysing fire growth, means of escape,<br>structural fire resistance and smoke control using a variety of methods,<br>including computer modelling software such as Computational Fluid Dynamics.</li> <li>Preparing technical reports and liaising with<br>clients, including some of the largest building developers in the country.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements and Qualifications</strong></p> <p>To set you up for success in the role, you’ll need:</p> <ul> <li>Right to work in the UK or Ireland.</li> <li>A Master’s degree, achieved within the last two<br>years or expected, in Fire Engineering, Mechanical Engineering,<br>Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering, or Physics.</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication<br>skills in English.</li> <li>Additional qualifications and experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>The following would also help you succeed in the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A team player who can work effectively with<br>colleagues at all levels.</li> <li>Excellent communication and time management<br>skills.</li> <li>Enthusiasm to innovate.</li> <li>A second European language is an advantage but<br>not essential.</li> </ul> <p>We’ve successfully welcomed Graduate Fire Engineers from a variety of STEM Master’s backgrounds, including Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace/Aeronautical Engineering and Physics. Many of these individuals have gone on to build outstanding careers with us.</p> <p>If you’re committed to pursuing a career in Fire Engineering and have a transferable STEM Master’s degree, we’d love to hear from you. Tell us why you’re ready to start your career with Jensen Hughes.</p> <p><strong>Graduate Development Programme</strong></p> <p>Starting your career is about more than your first role, it’s about building the foundations for your future.</p> <p>Our Graduate Development Programme gives you hands-on project experience, mentorship and support as you work towards professional accreditation. Over two years, you’ll gain experience across fire engineering and related disciplines, helping you build the knowledge and skills needed for a successful and impactful career.</p> <p>You’ll also have the opportunity to undertake <strong>Continuing Professional Development (CPD)</strong> as you progress through the programme, helping you continue to develop your technical knowledge and professional skills. We provide support and encouragement for Engineers working towards <strong>Chartered Engineer status</strong>, helping you work towards this important professional milestone as you build your career with Jensen Hughes.</p> <p><strong>Sustainability in Fire Engineering</strong></p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, fire safety and sustainability go hand in hand.</p> <p>In the UK, we support the design of safe, energy-efficient and sustainable buildings that meet BREEAM standards and align with net-zero goals. As a graduate, you’ll play a role in delivering solutions that protect people while helping to create a more sustainable built environment.</p> <p><strong>Our People Are Our Greatest Asset</strong></p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we know that our people are the foundation of our success. For certain teams, this may include an early Friday finish at 3 pm once contracted hours and client deadlines are met. We also offer:</p> <ul> <li>Flexible working hours and patterns</li> <li>Flexible holiday use over Christmas/New Year</li> <li>Enhanced holiday entitlement after three years</li> <li>The option to carry over up to five unused<br>holiday days into the next year (subject to discussion and approval)</li> </ul> <p><strong>A Commitment to Continuous Improvement</strong></p> <p>Our benefits represent a meaningful investment in both our people and the future of Jensen Hughes. title: Engagement Manager SMB
description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. About the role The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the center of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced, strategic Engagement Manager to join our growing team and help a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams fundamentally change the way they work with Legora. This is a role for someone who has developed and executed a scaled customer motion, and who knows that transformation across a large portfolio of clients has to be designed, automated and measured. You will drive adoption, technical health and commercial outcomes of your portfolio end-to-end by leveraging systems and technology while reserving high-touch interactions for the most impactful moments. You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption program at Legora, helping clients realize measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work. What You'll Do: You'll own the post-sale motion end-to-end for a large portfolio of law firms and corporate legal teams across our EMEA scaled portfolio. Specifically, you will: Improve the scaled adoption playbook: the tech-led onboarding, enablement, and change-management motions and target outcomes for how our scale customers adopt Legora and transform the way they work. Execute against that playbook, sequencing automated touchpoints and interventions from initial rollout to firm-wide adoption and adapting as the client's needs and Legora's capabilities evolve. Facilitate strategic touchpoints with your highest stakes accounts, while using one-to-many enablement to surface high-impact opportunities and guide the rest of the portfolio toward maximum value from Legora. Drive sustained value through a programmatic operating cadence: templated success plans, one-to-many enablement, scaled training and digital value reviews. Manage the health of the portfolio by monitoring adoption and utilization signals in our internal systems to proactively flag and act on risks and growth opportunities. Own the commercials for the scaled program end-to-end by running renewal and expansion as repeatable motions informed by exquisite portfolio hygiene, forecasting, and data utilization. Orchestrate engagement across cross-functional teams (Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Product Marketing, Support) to accelerate client success, maintaining end-to-end portfolio context and coordination. Translate scaled customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, and Product Marketing to inform roadmap, positioning, and enablement, and to represent the voice of the scaled segment. What You Bring You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation at scale has to be designed, automated and measured. You're proactive, systems-minded and comfortable making tradeoffs about where to intervene and where to let technology do the work. You take pride in being the reason customers adopt, grow and succeed. We’re looking for: A scaled customer success, renewal management, or customer education background, with a demonstrated track record of designing and delivering programs that serve large customer bases. Experience building repeatable adoption playbooks and educational programs and delivering them at scale across digital channels. 3+ years for Manager, 5+ years for Senior Manager, in scaled or digital customer success, customer operations, account management, or a related field, ideally with exposure to high-growth B2B AI verticals or Legal Tech. Leveling will depend on specific experience and fit for the segment. A track record of driving adoption, retention and expansion with a high-volume portfolio of clients. Ownership of a commercial number: you have carried GRR and NRR for a portfolio and run renewal and expansion yourself as repeatable motions, hitting the thresholds by leveraging data and automation. Technical fluency and systems thinking: you're comfortable configuring and deploying tooling (CS and CRM platforms, AI agents, LMS, data visualization platforms) to deliver outcomes. Data fluency and a metrics-driven approach to customer health, forecasting and portfolio strategy at scale. Exceptional program, project and prioritization skills; you keep many clients and multi-workstream initiatives moving concurrently. Excellent German and English communication skills — written, verbal, and interpersonal. High EQ: you know when to listen, when to advise and when to act. A love of fast-paced, early-stage environments where you help build the playbook, not just follow it. What we offer: The opportunity to join and grow within Legora’s SMB post-sale engagement team in EMEA. A role with real ownership of customer outcomes and visibility across product, go-to-market, and support functions. Collaboration with leadership and cross-functional teams to build systems that shape customer outcomes. A fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where excellence is rewarded, and growth is exponential. Competitive compensation, meaningful equity participation, and an office designed for focus and high performance. Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Head of Marketing (f/m/d)
description: Über uns: Zenjob ist eine KI-gestützte Plattform für flexible Personallösungen, die seit 2015 Unternehmen und temporäre Arbeitskräfte effizient miteinander verbindet. Unternehmen buchen über unsere Plattform kurzfristig einsatzbereite Mitarbeitende in Echtzeit, während Studierende unsere App nutzen, um Nebenjobs zu finden, die sich optimal mit ihrem Studium vereinbaren lassen. Über 40.000 Studierende und 1.000 Partnerunternehmen aus Logistik, Einzelhandel und Gastronomie in allen großen deutschen Städten teilen unseren Glauben daran, dass gute Arbeit kein Zufall ist. Gute Arbeit beginnt hier. Für die Fortführung unserer strategischen Aufbauarbeit suchen wir eine profilierte Führungspersönlichkeit, die nachhaltigen Markterfolg durch Effizienz, strategische Schärfe und kreative Exzellenz definiert – und beweist, dass starker Impact nicht von der Budgetgröße abhängt. Die Herausforderung: Maximaler Impact durch Gestaltungswille, Hands-on-Mentalität und strukturellen Team-Aufbau In dieser Schlüsselposition steuerst du das Wachstum von Zenjob nicht über die Verwaltung expansiver Media-Budgets oder das Management externer Agentur-Netzwerke. Gestaltungswille und Hands on Mentalität sind deine primären Hebel: Mit strategischen und kreativen Ideen, datenbasierten Optimierungen und operativer Eigenleistung schaffst du substanziellen Wert – sowohl im B2C- als auch im B2B-Segment. Hier erwartet dich eine anspruchsvolle Gestaltungsaufgabe: Unser Marketing-Team wurde neu aufgestellt, und Zenjob befindet sich in einer strategischen Umbauphase. Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Leader, der dem Team Orientierung und Struktur gibt, die Unternehmensstrategie in eine klare Vision für Zenjob übersetzt und diese in konkrete Jahres- und Quartalsziele herunterbricht. Als Schnittstelle zu Executive Team und Investoren verbindest du strategische Weitsicht und operative Umsetzungsstärke. Dein Team: Brand, CRM und Performance Marketing und der B2B Marketing Lead berichten an dich. Unser Creative Studio berichtet direkt an den Brand Lead und liefert die visuelle Power für deine Strategie. Um deine Entscheidungen datenseitig abzusichern, arbeitest du eng mit dedizierten Experten aus den Bereichen Analytics und Research zusammen, die als strategische Partner in den jeweiligen Experten-Abteilungen unserer Organisation verankert sind. Deine Aufgaben: Strategische Weiterentwicklung & Fundament: Du verantwortest die ganzheitliche Marketing-Strategie und führst die bereits geleistete Aufbau- und Grundlagenarbeit strukturiert in die nächste Wachstumsphase. Prozess- & Team-Aufbau : Du formst das neu zusammengestellte Team, etablierst moderne Arbeitsweisen, effiziente Workflows und klare Strukturen. Stimme der Marke & Kunden : Du vertrittst das Marketing in zentralen, cross-funktionalen Planungs- und Steuerungsmeetings. Als starke Stimme am Tisch beeinflusst du strategische Unternehmensentscheidungen konsequent aus Sicht des Kunden und der Marke. Effiziente Wachstumsstrategie: Konzeption und Implementierung von smarten, budgetschonenden Marketing Maßnahmen, die durch Ideenstärke statt durch hohes Media-Investment überzeugen. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung: Direkte Berichtslinie an den COO zur lückenlosen Synchronisation der Marketing-Ziele mit der operativen und kommerziellen Gesamtvision von Zenjob. Dein Profil Visionäres Markendenken: Du erkennst das Potenzial einer Marke, die noch nicht fertig ist, und hast Lust, daraus etwas Unverwechselbares zu machen. Du verstehst unsere besondere Zielgruppe und siehst Marke als Kern, der dem Unternehmen eine Ausrichtung gibt und Kunden und Mitarbeiter gleichermaßen begeistert. Langjährige Führungserfahrung: Du bist eine gestandene Leadership-Persönlichkeit, die nachweislich Teams geformt, Strukturen aufgebaut und Mitarbeiter erfolgreich durch Transformationsphasen gecoacht hat. Full-Funnel-Expertise: Tiefgehendes, praxiserprobtes Verständnis für das synergetische Zusammenspiel von Brand, CRM, Performance Marketing und B2B-Marketing. Resilienz und strategischer Weitblick: Ausgewiesene Erfahrung in der strukturellen Aufbauarbeit. Du agierst auch bei der Definition neuer Prozesse mit der nötigen Geduld, Gelassenheit und strategischer Ausdauer. Multidimensionale Perspektive: Du bist mit den Dynamiken des Startup-Sektors vertraut, hast deine Kompetenzen jedoch gleichermaßen in etablierten, strukturell reiferen Unternehmensstrukturen unter Beweis gestellt. Du beherrschst die Balance zwischen Agilität und Corporate-Professionalität. Ressourcenorientierter Ansatz: Du setzt auf die Befähigung interner Talente, smarte Ideen und ein starkes Netzwerk im Unternehmen statt auf externe Dienstleister. Wir bieten Substanzieller Gestaltungsspielraum Die Möglichkeit, die strategische Ausrichtung, die internen Strukturen und die Markenidentität eines Marktführers in der digitalen Personalvermittlung maßgeblich von Grund auf zu prägen. 🏖️ Zeit zum Abschalten & Auftanken 28 Urlaubstage (steigen alle zwei Kalenderjahre um 1 auf max. 30 Tage) 1 bezahlter Sonderurlaubstag pro Jahr für ehrenamtliche Arbeit 5 Tage bezahlter Bildungsurlaub Möglichkeit für unbezahlten Urlaub 10 bezahlte Tage beim krankheitsbedingten Ausfall deines Kindes 🚀 Weiterentwicklung & Lernen 1000€ jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget pro Mitarbeiter:in Zusätzliches Team-Trainingsbudget & interne Workshops Mentoring, Karrierecoachings & Zenjob University 🏠 Arbeit, die zu deinem Leben passt Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: bis zu 2 Tage/Woche remote (1 Tag in den ersten 6 Monaten für bestmögliches Onboarding) Flexible Arbeitszeiten Modernes, lichtdurchflutetes Büro in Prenzlauer Berg Hundefreundliches Arbeitsumfeld 💪 Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden 30 € monatlicher Zuschuss für Urban Sports Club 25 % Rabatt auf Mitgliedschaften bei FitX Eigener kleiner Meditationsraum im Büro 🥗 Verpflegung & Office-Life Monatliches Monday Lunch, kostenlose Getränke, Obst- & Gemüsekorb Bis zu 115,05 €/Monat steuerfreier Essenszuschuss über Circula Snacks & Drinks nach unseren All Hands Meetings 🚲 Nachhaltige Mobilität 40 € monatliches Guthaben bei NAVIT (ÖPNV, Bike-Sharing u.v.m.) 💼 Finanzen & Vorsorge Betriebliche Altersvorsorge über Finsurancy zu attraktiven Gruppenkonditionen Übertragungsservice für bestehende betriebliche Rentenverträge 🎉 Kultur & Teamspirit Vierteljährliche Teamevents, Sommer- & Winterparty Budget für Geburtstage & Firmenjubiläen Unsere Werte werden gelebt: Humble, Helpful, Hungry & Honest Bewirb dich und schicke uns deine Unterlagen. title: Werkstudent Office & Team Management (F/M/*)
description: Aus Europa, für Europa – Wir bauen Europas Business-KI. Wir sind amber, eines der am schnellsten wachsenden KI-Startups aus Deutschland. KMUs profitieren davon, wenn internes Wissen sofort nutzbar wird und intelligente Agenten darauf reagieren können. Wir glauben an eine Zukunft, in der Business-KI, einschließlich Agenten, innerhalb von amber und anderen Plattformen, auf einer gemeinsamen Kontextschicht arbeitet, sodass Teams schneller arbeiten, Übergaben nahtlos erfolgen und das Know-how im Unternehmen bleibt. Du organisierst gerne, behältst den Überblick und sorgst dafür, dass im Team alles rundläuft? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Als Werkstudent im Office & Team Management (F/M*) unterstützt du unser Team im Tagesgeschäft, hilfst bei der Planung von Events und bringst eigene Ideen ein, damit unser Arbeitsalltag noch reibungsloser wird. Du bist gerne mit unterschiedlichen Menschen im Austausch und hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen? Bei uns bekommst du Einblicke in verschiedene Bereiche des Unternehmens und kannst aktiv mitgestalten – von Office-Themen über Team-Events bis hin zur Optimierung interner Abläufe. Aufgaben Du wirkst bei der Planung und Organisation von Teamevents mit – vom Sommerfest über gemeinsame Workations bis hin zur Weihnachtsfeier. Du hilfst bei anfallenden Aufgaben wie Hardware- und Bürobestellungen. Du unterstützt dabei, Optimierungspotenziale zu erkennen und interne Prozesse durch passende Tools und Ideen zu vereinfachen. Du unterstützt bei der Vorbereitung und Koordination von Verträgen und behältst wichtige Abläufe und Fristen im Blick. Du kümmerst dich gemeinsam mit dem Team um unsere Büros und hilfst dabei, unsere Office Culture durch passende Vor-Ort-Formate zu stärken. Du hilfst bei verschiedenen Projekten und wirkst an der strategischen und operativen Weiterentwicklung des Unternehmens mit. Qualifikationen Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in und hast Lust, praktische Erfahrungen im Office- und Teammanagement zu sammeln. Du bist ein:e Teamplayer:in, kommunizierst gerne und hast ein gutes Gespür für zwischenmenschliche Beziehungen. Du hast Spaß daran, Aufgaben zu organisieren und interne Events mitzuplanen. Du arbeitest sorgfältig, selbstständig und behältst auch bei mehreren Aufgaben den Überblick. title: Senior Platform Engineer (f/m/x)
description: Your role with us As Senior Platform Engineer , you own the platform that Workist's AI agents run on: two clouds, the Kubernetes clusters for production, staging and ML workloads, and the path from merge request to production for every service we ship. We self-host only where it clearly pays off. Two clouds: Azure as our primary cloud, AWS for search and mail ingestion. Python everywhere: read and fix application code when that is where the fix belongs. Security is routine: automated scanning in every pipeline, regular external pentests, quarterly backup and disaster-recovery tests. Your responsibilities Own the platform Own the architecture of our cloud environments across Azure and AWS: how subscriptions, networks, identities and environments are structured and stay isolated Design and deliver the platform capabilities the product needs next, from GPU capacity and an LLM gateway to new environments Set the standard for how we run Kubernetes and our managed data services: capacity planned ahead of growth, changes and upgrades rolled out safely and routinely, costs kept in check Keep it quiet Own the security posture end to end: least-privilege access, network isolation, findings from scanners and pentests, and a patch cadence that runs itself. Schlüsselfertiges Geschäftsmodell: Live und online Onboarding workshops verteilt auf zwei Monate, Methodik, Online-Werkzeuge, Vorlagen und ein Startprogramm für die Mandantengewinnung. Unterstützung bei der Lead-Generierung: In der Startphase unterstützen wir Sie bei der Gewinnung von Erstkontakten zu Geschäftsinhabern, damit Sie schneller zu ersten Gesprächen kommen und Ihr Mandantenstamm zügiger wächst. title: Tax & Finance Operations Interns (f/m/d) - AI Tax Startup
description: We are building Germany's leading Tax Advisory firm. Taxforce was founded based on a simple observation: Many business owners want a tax advisor who acts as a true sparring partner: proactive, responsive, and strategic. What they often get instead is a service provider: booking receipts and filing tax returns, with little real advisory. We’re building the alternative. Founded in 2025, Taxforce rethinks tax advisory from the ground up: AI-powered and highly automated, yet personal. We’re starting with healthcare professionals, a complex and underserved segment, with the ambition to expand into many more industries over time. Instead of pure compliance, we deliver real advisory and become long-term partners to our clients: from initial setup to established organizations. This is a €40B market in Germany alone, with processes that have barely changed in decades. AI is now enabling a fundamental shift and there are no playbooks yet. We’re writing them. We’re a small, highly ambitious team in Berlin, backed by €5M from Tenet VC and founded by alumni of Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company and the former Klarna Head of Engineering. You’ll work directly with the founders, take on real responsibility from day one, and see how AI transforms a real-world industry. We offer a high-ownership environment, direct feedback and mentoring, a collaborative team, and competitive salary all from our office near Boxhagener Platz. Join early and help us redefine tax advisory. Tasks As a Tax & Finance Intern, you'll work right in the middle of our operational and advisory tax work . You'll take on responsibility from day one, both e xternally, supporting our tax advisors, and internally, in our own controlling and bookkeeping along the entire value chain: from preparing client tax returns and hands-on research, to managing invoicing, funds, and cashflow, through our monthly internal financial close. Because tech and tax work together at Taxforce, you'll be close to the point where manual work turns into automation and you'll actively help us make our processes better: : Finance & controlling Take ownership of our invoicing and support funds and cashflow management Support the monthly internal bookkeeping and financial close Build and maintain reporting and controlling analyses over time Tax Operational work Prepare ongoing financial accounting: receipt capture, booking, account reconciliation Prepare annual financial statement packages and business analyses: Provide simple input on tax returns and pre-filings (income tax, business taxes) at draft level, where you get feedback and develop new skills Support our digital mail and tax assessment processing through deadline control and smart document classification Structured client communication (document requests, follow-ups) Maintain client master data and support deadline contro Tech & automation Test and document internal tools and workflows Contribute to automating recurring tasks (e.g. document classification, data extraction, integrations) Data preparation and simple analyses Requirements Drive & ambition: You're excited to work motivated to work in a young team and thrive in fast-paced startup environments. Relevant studies: You're studying business administration, economics, law, tax or a related field, ideally with a focus on or strong interest in tax, accounting or finance First practical experience: You've gained hands-on experience through internships or working student roles (ideally in Tax, Accounting, Finance or Consulting) Care & accuracy: You work carefully and precisely, because in tax and finance every detail counts Structured & independent: You organise yourself well, prioritise between tasks and get things done without needing everything spelled out Tech-savvy: You're comfortable using AI tools and can implement small automations yourself and you have no problem with learning new tools and skills on the go Collaborative: You are a team player. Working together as a team and sharing knowledge comes naturally to you German language skills: We are a fast growing start-up with a diverse team. However, our customers do mostly speak German. Hence we require German language skills. Benefits Learn from an experienced team: Work closely with founders and tax advisors and get direct feedback and mentoring from day one Ownership from day one : Take on real responsibility early and help shape how Taxforce is built across tax, finance, and operations Front-row seat to AI in the real world : See how AI is applied to transform a traditional industry and actively contribute to building an AI-driven product Steep learning curve: Work on real clients and real numbers, not example cases, and build skills that carry into your career Strong team environment : Join an ambitious, supportive team with direct feedback and a high level of trust and ownership Fair working student salary and a great office: Competitive pay and flexible hours around your studies, from our office near Boxhagener Platz Office Policy: We work 5 days in the office, because we feel that is crucial to enable speed, learning, and compounding interests when working next to each other. title: Strategic Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who we are </strong></p> <p>At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to<a class="c-link" href="https://customers.twilio.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://customers.twilio.com/" data-sk="tooltip_parent"> hundreds of thousands of businesses </a>and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.</p> <p>Our dedication to <a class="c-link" href="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work" data-sk="tooltip_parent">remote-first work</a>, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.<br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p> <p><strong>Hiring and how we work</strong></p> <p>We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! </p> <p>Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. <br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p></div><p><strong>See yourself at Twilio</strong></p> <p>Join the team as Twilio’s next Strategic Account Executive.</p> <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>This position is needed to sell into high value prospects and customers. This person will play a key role in further growing the business across EMEA with a particular focus on Northern Europe. The candidate will be responsible for managing fast growing customers in the region. Focused mainly on Product cross and up-sell and revenue growth, as well as sourcing net new opportunities within a set of accounts.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>In this role, you’ll:</p> <ul> <li>Servicing the fastest growing customers in the region.</li> <li>Growing our revenue and share of wallet within your key account list. </li> <li>Opening doors to the purchase of Twilio’s products and services - including voice, messaging, email, contact centre, account security software.</li> <li>Maintaining the highest levels of customer satisfaction.</li> <li>Create pricing proposals, negotiating terms and managing the contract process.</li> <li>Selling solutions to a technical and business audience. </li> <li>Building trust and mutual respect with technical customers and peers.</li> <li>Thinking outside of the box and having extraordinary interpersonal and communication skills to make complex contractual, technical, and financial details sound simple.</li> <li>Balancing challenging priorities and handling multiple projects/deals at the same time.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications </strong></p> <p>Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!</p> <p><strong>*Required:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of Account Management/Sales experience covering selling and closing complex technical solutions to a large customer base. </li> <li>History of working with accounts ranging from large multinational enterprise customers to Digital Natives. </li> <li>Experience building and maintaining relationships up to C-suite.</li> <li>Demonstrated success by achieving quota on a consistent basis.</li> <li>Track record of Account Management experience and a solid understanding of how to cross and upsell solutions within a mature customer base. </li> <li>A solid understanding of financial reporting within a direct customer base - Revenue tracking</li> <li>Experience selling both to a business and technical stakeholders.  </li> </ul> <p><strong>Desired:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience and understanding of working in the communications market is preferable.  Have sold or worked with Messaging, Voice, Email, Contact Centre, Account Security Verification.  Or have prior experience in a traditional telecommunications environment/business.</li> <li>Curious networker </li> </ul> <p><strong>Location</strong></p> <p>The position will be remote and based in the United Kingdom or Ireland.</p> <p><strong>Travel </strong></p> <p>We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25%  travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.</p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Twilio thinks big. Do you?</strong></p> <p>We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/values">Twilio Magic</a>. Additionally, we empower employees to build <a href="https://twilio.org/support-and-resources/impact-fund">positive change in their communities</a> by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.</p> <p>So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/jobs#open-positions">please consider other open positions.</a></p> <p><strong><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Stay alert to recruitment fraud</strong></p> <p>We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @<a href="http://twilio.com">twilio.com</a> email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.<br><br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.</strong> We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Solutions Engineer, EMEA
description: <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Abnormal AI is looking for a Customer Solutions Engineer to join the Technical Account Management team. This role gives Abnormal a flexible, technical resource for situations that fall between standard support and a long-term, dedicated Technical Account Manager. Customer Solutions Engineers are floating technical specialists who partner with CSMs for the duration of a specific need, triggered by things like recurring support cases, asks beyond the typical support experience, or short-term project-based work. The ideal candidate combines deep technical fluency with strong triage judgment and is comfortable moving between engagements without an existing playbook.</p> <h2>What you will do </h2> <ul> <li>Serve as a flexible technical resource CSMs can bring into challenging or recurring account situations that a standard support case isn't built to resolve.</li> <li>Take on short-term, project-based technical engagements for customers without a dedicated TAM.</li> <li>Partner with CSMs to assess customer technical needs, join investigative or best-practices calls, and determine the right next step.</li> <li>Lead hands-on platform optimization: configuration reviews, best-practices setup, and proactive tuning that prevents issues from recurring.</li> <li>Document session recaps and next steps in the CRM so recommendations are clear to the customer and visible to the broader team.</li> <li>Advise customers on underused contracted features and flag upsell or professional services/deployment opportunities where relevant.</li> <li>Recognize when a situation exceeds this role's scope and hand it to the Critical Situation Manager or Technical Support with a clear, documented hand-off.</li> <li>Surface patterns across engagements to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to drive systemic improvement.</li> </ul> <h2>Must Haves </h2> <ul> <li>3+ years in a customer-facing technical role (email infrastructure, IT security/administration, engineering, or technical support) in enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity</li> <li>Solid grounding in Abnormal's platform and configuration best practices, sufficient to work independently with customers without a senior technical resource in the room</li> <li>Strong triage judgment; able to recognize quickly whether a situation calls for hands-on technical guidance or a more senior technical resource</li> <li>Comfortable stepping into a customer relationship for a defined engagement and stepping back out; this is not a standing account-ownership role</li> <li>Able to manage multiple concurrent, time-bound engagements across a broad book of business rather than a fixed set of named accounts</li> <li>Excellent communication skills across technical and business stakeholders, including comfort presenting to senior customer stakeholders</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to Have </h2> <ul> <li>Familiarity with email authentication/delivery protocols and cloud email platforms (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace)</li> <li>Prior experience in a floating/pooled technical resource model (e.g., professional services, deployment, or solutions engineering)</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>#LI-AA1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>A note on AI in our process: <br></strong>Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.</p> <p>Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please <a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt3a076cfd9753fa1f/blt9cbda641db7c0045/6a1e3d3a66aea075cd33e462/AAP_and_EEO_Statement.pdf" target="_blank"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><em>click here</em></span></a>. title: Data Scientist, Help Experience
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>Help Experience (HEX) supports tens of millions of Vinted members across 20+ markets. When members encounter an issue—from shipping delays to payment questions—we want to resolve it as fast, effortlessly, and accurately as possible.</p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join the Ember team within the Help Experience domain.</p> <p>Ember is building the next generation of AI-powered support at Vinted. Our mission is to <em>serve scalable support automation that users appreciate</em>. We build and scale our conversational Virtual Assistant and automated resolution systems, transforming support from traditional ticketing into instant, conversational problem-solving. By resolving issues autonomously and helping members get back to buying and selling with confidence, Ember directly reduces operating costs and manual ticket volume supporting Vinted’s mission to make second-hand the first choice worldwide.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Build Conversational AI & Agentic Systems:</strong> Design, develop, and scale LLM-powered virtual assistants and agents capable of multi-turn dialogue, understanding nuanced member intent, and reasoning over complex marketplace policies and real-time transaction data.</li> <li><strong>Drive Autonomous Resolution & Decisioning:</strong> Build decision systems and classification models that know when an issue can be safely and autonomously resolved (including executing automated actions like cancellations, tracking updates, or refunds) versus when to seamlessly hand off to human support specialists.</li> <li><strong>Leverage Modern GenAI & RAG Architectures:</strong> Implement and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, prompt engineering, and fine-tuning techniques to deliver accurate, context-aware answers across multiple languages and noisy conversational inputs.</li> <li><strong>Establish Robust Evaluation & Guardrails:</strong> Design offline and online LLM evaluation frameworks (measuring policy compliance, hallucination mitigation, response safety, and containment quality) to ensure automated interactions are dependable and aligned with brand guidelines.</li> <li><strong>Ship to Production at Scale:</strong> Partner closely with Backend Engineers and ML Platform teams to deploy and serve models in low-latency, high-throughput production environments, monitoring for drift and performance degradation in real time.</li> <li><strong>Partner for Impact:</strong> Collaborate with Product Managers, Decision Scientists, and Customer Support Operations to identify high-impact automation opportunities, design rigorous A/B experiments, and directly move core metrics like Automation Rate, Containment, and Chatbot CSAT.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Pragmatic Problem Solver:</strong> You have a strong technical background and hands-on experience developing machine learning algorithms. You prefer an iterative approach and can read a research paper and translate it into clean, replicable code.</li> <li><strong>Service Mindset:</strong> You understand that behind every data point is a real member trying to get help. You succeed when the teams using your tools can make better decisions for our members.</li> <li><strong>Technical Expertise:</strong> You are highly skilled in <strong>Python</strong> and <strong>SQL</strong>. You write clean, maintainable, and structured code that serves as an inspiration for others, valuing reproducibility, clarity, and performance.</li> <li><strong>Clear Communicator:</strong> You can persuasively explain complex technical concepts and their business implications to non-data stakeholders. You understand that stakeholders need to know <em>why</em> a model gave a certain score.</li> <li>Fluent in written and spoken English.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>30 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per your workday</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Access to a discounted gym membership plan</li> <li>Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution</li> <li>Supplemental Private Health Insurance</li> <li>Life and Disability insurance</li> <li>A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy </strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid work </strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€74.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€100.100 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Designer EMEA
description: WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity. Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures. The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In . We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Senior Product Designer at WunderGraph, you are the connection between what our users will find most helpful and what our engineers build. Considering the users also happen to be other developers, this becomes an interesting challenge to think about the Developer Experience as the User Experience. You combine sharp user insight, craft, and pragmatism to deliver experiences that are elegant, usable, and built to scale. This is a wide-reaching role, as design roles at a startup should be. One week you might be running user interviews to shape a new feature; the next, refining our design system or designing a marketing landing page. You ground your work in evidence rather than assumption, partner closely with product and engineering, and turn what you learn about users into a clear, informed UX strategy that guides where we go next. TEAM INTEGRATION Reports to the VP of Product; is part of the Product team Aligns closely with the CEO (Product) and Head of Customer Success (customer experience and business impact) Collaborate within the Product team with the Delivery Lead and the Design Engineer Collaborates cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, product, and customer success ROLE OBJECTIVES You are successful if you: Take ownership of the complete design lifecycle, bridging the gap between initial discovery and final delivery for web and product interfaces. Cultivate an evidence-based UX strategy that leverages user research and data to steer the product's evolution. Oversee the growth of a unified and extensible design system that spans both our product and marketing efforts. Convert user insights and organizational objectives into pragmatic, human-centric solutions engineered for long-term scalability. Advocate for excellence in accessibility, responsiveness, and performance as fundamental pillars of your craft. Provide mentorship to the team, sharing expertise in research methodologies and design principles. Refine the visual and functional identity of WunderGraph through meticulous and high-impact design work. Impact high-level product strategy by demonstrating how user-focused decisions drive tangible business impact. ROLE TASKS The role focuses on, but is not limited to: Product Design Design and prototype user flows, interfaces, and interactions with scalability in mind. Own design problems end to end. From initial concept through execution and iteration after launch. Rapidly produce wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, exploring multiple concepts and iterating quickly. Define and evolve our design system and component library, keeping it consistent and maintainable. Partner closely with engineers on feasibility, quality, and handoff, contributing to technical decisions (and coding where you're comfortable and it helps as a plus, not a requirement). Introduce advanced prototyping, interaction design, and motion practices. UX Research & Strategy Plan and conduct user research across discovery and validation via user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and competitor analysis. Turn ambiguous product questions into decision-grade research that maps to real product and design decisions. Synthesize findings into clear insights, personas, journey maps, and opportunity areas that the team can act on. Build and maintain a shared insight repository so learning is reusable, searchable, and available to everyone. title: Senior Solution Consultant (Pre-Sales) - DACH
description: AMPECO is one of the most innovative companies in the area of electric vehicle charging infrastructure – an industry that aims to change the world by making charging easier for everyone. As electric vehicles (EVs) are bringing in a transformation of our transport and mobility sectors, AMPECO is at the forefront of a grand revolution and we’re just getting started. Our product – the AMPECO EV Charging Platform is a business-critical SaaS platform used by companies to manage their electric vehicle charging infrastructure, processes and energy use. While the BDM leads the commercial relationship, you own the solution end to end: mapping each prospect’s business needs to AMPECO’s platform, leading demonstrations and Proof-of-Concept engagements, owning bid management for DACH opportunities — from RFx and tenders through to the supporting business case — and making the complex feel clear for everyone in the room. As we continue to grow across Germany and the wider region, the impact you make here will be significant — with room to grow alongside it. If you thrive in fast-paced, complex enterprise environments, enjoy working with highly driven teams, and want to play a pivotal role in the energy transition in one of Europe’s most important EV markets, this role is for you. Responsibilities Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of AMPECO’s platform and the e-mobility industry, with a strong grasp of the DACH market and its requirements; Act as the solutioning lead on strategic DACH opportunities, working hand in hand with the DACH Business Development Manager to map each prospect’s business needs to AMPECO’s capabilities; Drive Proof-of-Concept engagements with prospective clients, ensuring the business drivers are sound, relevant, and build a compelling case to advance the opportunity; Design and deliver effective demonstrations that connect AMPECO’s solution advantages to prospects’ business and technical requirements; Build and maintain trusted relationships with the key stakeholders involved in DACH deals, becoming a credible advisor throughout the sales cycle; Take an active advisory role during sales cycles, bringing solution expertise and industry best practices to the team; Own bid management for DACH opportunities — taking end-to-end responsibility for RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, and tenders, from structuring and writing the response to coordinating input across teams and managing deadlines; Represent AMPECO at industry events across the region and stay close to market trends, the competitive landscape, and evolving customer needs; Travel across the DACH region as needed for customer engagements, workshops, and events. Your Profile 6+ years of professional experience, including 3+ years in a pre-sales, solution consulting, or similar sales-focused role within enterprise or B2B software; Native-level German and fluent English, both spoken and written — you will work with German-speaking enterprise customers daily; Strong pre-sales execution skills: solution design, demonstrations, Proof-of-Concepts, and bid / RFx management; Tech-savvy and a fast learner on technical topics — comfortable holding technical conversations and explaining how the platform works, without needing to be a deeply technical specialist or engineer; A confident communicator, able to build rapport and credibility with senior business and technical stakeholders and to present complex topics clearly; Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex challenges and shape solutions for evolving business models; Strong business acumen — able to articulate customer value and connect AMPECO’s platform to strategic outcomes; Based in Germany, self-driven and well-organised, and comfortable operating effectively in a remote, distributed team across the DACH region; Naturally curious, with a genuine interest in continuously learning about the product and the industry; A collaborative team player who works seamlessly with Sales, Product, and other specialists; Motivated to build a long-term career in the e-mobility sector. Considered an advantage Domain knowledge in mobility, energy, or a related sector; Familiarity with EV charging technology and standards such as OCPP, OCPI, or ISO 15118; Experience working in a SaaS or PaaS environment with long, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles; Background in consulting or professional services; Experience in enterprise sales; Fluency in an additional European language (e.g. French, Italian). What we offer Competitive salary and benefits package; Flexibility to work from anywhere in Germany or from a modern co-working space in Munich's Werksviertel, near Ostbahnhof; Opportunity to grow with a mission-driven startup in a high-impact industry. Our team at AMPECO is deeply committed to our mission and we're looking for like-minded individuals eager to give, learn and grow with us. If you're passionate about innovative technology and want to make a real impact in the e-mobility sector, we want to hear from you. Join AMPECO in building the future of EV charging! title: Teamleiter Vertrieb (m/w/d)

title: Solutions Architect f/m/d
description: <p>Apaleo is the world’s most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.</p> <h3>Why this role</h3> <p>You are the technical voice in front of strategic customers, at a moment when hospitality is being rebuilt around AI. We are launching our own AI agent platform, and we need architects who can show operators what comes next.</p> <ul> <li><strong>High trust.</strong> You own the technical answer in front of strategic customers and deals.</li> <li><strong>High visibility.</strong> Your work shows up in deals, key accounts and customer stories, and it reaches Product.</li> <li><strong>High freedom.</strong> You decide how to solve a problem, which tools to use and what to prototype.</li> <li><strong>Fast iteration.</strong> We test ideas within days, try new technology early and share what works.</li> </ul> <h3>Your mission</h3> <p>Win and grow strategic accounts with technical credibility, and turn what you learn in the field into input for the product. You look at a customer's current architecture and show how an Apaleo-centred setup delivers their goals. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. You own the technical answer.</p> <h3>What you will do</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Technical discovery and solution scoping.</strong> Lead discovery where a standard demo is not enough. Write clear scopes covering what Apaleo delivers natively, what needs a short-term solution and what is out of scope.</li> <li><strong>Proofs of concept.</strong> Build fast, working proofs of concept (quick demos that show technical fit). Agree scope in writing first, and build in a safe test environment, never with live guest data.</li> <li><strong>Agents and automations.</strong> Design and build agents and automations for customer use cases, using n8n or Make today and Apaleo's own AI agent platform as it launches. Write code where agents need deterministic steps.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on delivery and short-term solutions.</strong> Work alongside the customer, building only where it unblocks a named deal, removes an adoption risk or fills a product gap. Agree an exit plan (an end date, a replacement and a named owner) before you start.</li> <li><strong>Post-sale health checks and expansions.</strong> Diagnose gaps against the go-live specification, run proactive checks (for example 90 days after go-live) and scope integrations for expanding customers.</li> <li><strong>Reusable assets.</strong> Turn every engagement into a reference architecture, pattern or template that the next twenty customers can use.</li> <li><strong>Thought leadership.</strong> Join prospect and customer conversations on how AI will change hospitality over the next two to three years.</li> <li><strong>Product feedback.</strong> Test new technology on real customer problems. Share prototypes and field evidence with Product, ending every experiment with a clear decision: adopt, hand over or drop.</li> </ul> <h3>How you work</h3> <ul> <li>You decide the approach, the stack and the order of work.</li> <li>You protect three guardrails: written scope before a proof of concept, an exit plan before a custom build and no commercial promises.</li> <li>You go from idea to prototype in days and show it early.</li> <li>You think in systems and build for reuse, not one-off projects.</li> <li>You share findings openly with Sales, Account Management and Product.</li> </ul> <h3>Who you work with</h3> <p>Sales/BD and Account Management (they call you in at defined deal triggers), Customer Success, Product, Security, Partnerships, RevOps and Senior Leadership. </p> <h3>What you bring</h3> <p><strong>Must have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Multiple years in solution architecture, solution engineering or technical consulting in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex software such as ERP or enterprise platforms</li> <li>Strong API skills: REST, authentication, webhooks and events, and data-flow design</li> <li>Hands-on workflow automation (n8n preferred) and practical experience building with LLM agents</li> <li>A systems thinker with real AI curiosity, who uses AI tools day to day</li> <li>Stakeholder management experience and credibility with executives and IT teams</li> <li>Self-direction, an ownership mindset and the discipline to say no to scope that does not advance a deal</li> <li>Curiosity that ends in working prototypes, not just opinions</li> <li>Clear, structured documentation habits</li> <li>Fluent English and French skills</li> <li>Willingness to travel, including regularly to France and the UK</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strong plus</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hospitality or travel experience, including hotel operations and PMS concepts (reservations, folios, rate plans, night audit)</li> <li>Experience with another cloud PMS, description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. The Role Evaluation is how we decide which models, checkpoints and recipes ship. As a Research Engineer on the Eval Platform team, you will build the infrastructure every science team relies on to measure model quality, and make it reliable, reproducible and fast. You don't need to have designed benchmarks before. You do need to care about what a score means, and about when a difference between two runs is real. What you will do Build systems that keep eval results reproducible and comparable over time, as models, benchmarks and code evolve. Run evaluations at scale across our GPU clusters, from model serving to scoring. Make eval results easy to access, explore and trust, through APIs and dashboards that researchers use every day. Catch broken or noisy evals before they mislead research decisions. Support evaluation of agentic, multi-turn and tool-using models. Work closely with researchers to turn new evaluation needs into robust, shared tooling. What we're looking for Master's or PhD in Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 4+ years building production-grade software, ideally large-scale ML codebases or distributed systems. Excellent Python and strong software-design instincts: testing, code review, CI/CD. Experience running workloads on GPU clusters (Slurm, Kubernetes, Ray or similar). Familiarity with LLM inference and evaluation. A product mindset: researchers are your users. Self-starter, low-ego, collaborative. Nice to have Experience building or maintaining evaluation harnesses or benchmarks. Hands-on experience with inference engines such as vLLM or SGLang. Experience with agentic or RL environments. Statistics for experimentation: variance estimation, significance testing. Open-source contributions to ML tooling.
