title: Director of Group Operations Strategy & Development
description: <p>📍London / Remote | 💰£112,200 - £151,800, L70 on the Operations Framework + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>⭐️ Our team</strong></p> <p>Our North Star in Operations is to deliver seamless support that builds trust, deepens loyalty, and powers Monzo’s sustainable, profitable growth.</p> <p>Sitting at the very heart of Monzo Global Operations, you will work within our Group COO team, partnering closely with the Global Operations Leadership team and key Monzo stakeholders to tackle our biggest strategic priorities in pursuit of our challenging goals. You will bridge the gap between bold ambition and rigorous operational execution - turning complex challenges and priorities into clear, measurable actions to progress across UK Operations, EU Operations and Controls. In this role you will build strong relationships with leadership across Customer Operations, EU Operations, Controls, Finance, Tech disciplines and the wider Monzo team, working collaboratively to help build and deliver on our Group COO strategy and operating model.</p> <h4><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></h4> <p><strong>Setting the GCOO Strategy</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Shape and own the big picture:</strong> You’ll define, align, and maintain a clear strategy for the Group COO team. Making sure it covers everything across UK Ops, EU Ops, and Controls, so everyone knows where we’re heading and why.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Goal Setting & Alignment</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Align our goals:</strong> you’ll lead the goal-setting process for the GCOO area. Making sure our top-level objectives fit seamlessly with the goals of each sub-function, keeping all our teams rowing in the same direction.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Control & Insight</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Keep us on budget with clear insights:</strong> You’ll partner closely with Finance to build and embed a simple, dependable monthly reporting process. Bringing real rigour and clear forecasting to the numbers so we always understand our financial health.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Global Operating Model</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Design for a global Monzo:</strong> you’ll lead the shift as GCOO transitions into a fully functioning global operating model - building everything with a "global by design" mindset from day one. You’ll help architect how we scale by balancing global efficiency with local market operational requirements, always ensuring we think “global first”.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strategic Project Delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Deliver key projects:</strong> You’ll take full accountability for a range of high-impact short and medium-term strategic projects, collaborating with teams across all of Monzo to get them over the line.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Tracking & Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Keep everyone informed:</strong> You’ll track our progress against the GCOO strategy and make sure key updates are clearly communicated - whether that’s for CEO reporting, the PRA 90-Day Plan, or our own GCOO Leadership Team.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h4> <ul> <li>You have extensive experience operating at a senior strategic level (ideally within fintech, or complex operational environments). You have a track record of shaping business strategy through structured problem-solving, data, and deep business insight.</li> <li>You are a proven executor, able to turn strategy into executable projects, ensuring those projects deliver to time and quality.  You switch between the strategic and practical with ease, analysing issues strategically but also being able to ‘do the detail’ to ensure successful execution</li> <li>You excel in highly matrixed environments where ownership is shared. You know how to build alignment, resolve trade-offs, and hold cross-functional teams accountable without needing direct reporting lines.</li> <li>You speak the language of Operations, Finance, Technology and Controls. You can comfortably translate complex operational or technical signals into clear executive narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>You thrive in unstructured environments where no playbook exists. You enjoy establishing governance, clear communication strategies and moving fluidly between strategic vision and hands-on operational delivery.</li> <li>You bring financial discipline and analytical capability, with hands-on experience partnering with Finance to connect operational levers directly to commercial performance.</li> <li>You have experience and strong aptitude for navigating complex global versus local operational structures and managing trade-offs across multiple markets</li> <li>You have superb communication skills with a proven ability to distill complex ideas and metrics into actionable insights through effective story-telling, high-impact board decks, and clear leadership updates.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 3* key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Application questions - </strong>we have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo" target="_blank"> <u>You can read them here.</u></a></li> <li><strong>Recruiter Call - 30 mins</strong> </li> <li><strong>1st stage Technical Interview - 1 hour</strong></li> <li>*potential additional stage to be decided.</li> </ul> <p>The closing date for applications is <strong>9am Monday 19th October </strong></p> <p>If you're successful in applying for this role, <strong>the standard release period is 8 weeks</strong>. This gives your current team time to plan for your move and ensures a smooth handover, while setting you up for success in your new role.</p> <p>Sometimes teams may be able to release people sooner, and if that’s the case, Hiring will work with your current manager to agree to a shorter release period. Whatever the timeline, we’ll make sure you’re kept in the loop and supported throughout.</p> <p>If you have any queries, please reach out to @Neens (please note I am on annual leave 6th to 19th October)</p> <p>Good luck 🍀</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer, AI Enablement
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. <em data-stringify-type="italic">Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. </em><em data-stringify-type="italic">We encourage you to help us break that statistic!</em></p> <p><strong>About Tailscale </strong></p> <p>Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.</p></div><h3><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About the Role</strong></span></h3> <p>We're seeking a talented and motivated full-time Software Engineer, AI Enablement to help Tailscale's engineering organization get the most out of AI-assisted development. You'll join a small, high-leverage team reporting to our co-founder, working alongside our first AI enablement engineer to build the tools, workflows, and practices that help every engineer at Tailscale build faster and more safely with AI. This is a foundational role — you'll have real latitude to shape what AI enablement means here as we scale, with direct visibility into how the whole engineering org adopts these tools.</p> <h3><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>Partner with engineering leadership and Tailscale's technical staff to define and drive our internal AI-enablement roadmap.</li> <li>Work closely with the team building Aperture by Tailscale, our AI gateway used both internally and offered as a product.</li> <li>Build and iterate on the tools, workflows, and shared practices that help engineers get real value from coding agents — and evaluate new models and tools, making clear calls on what we adopt.</li> <li>Partner with engineering and non-engineering teams to find high-leverage opportunities to apply AI — this is a support function, so success means other teams shipping faster because of what you've built.</li> <li>Establish the guardrails, review practices, and documentation that make AI-generated code safe to ship, and act as the internal advocate who helps teams adopt good practices without mandating a single tool.</li> <li>Track adoption and measure the real impact of AI tooling on velocity and quality, and report back to leadership.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What We Are Looking For</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of professional software engineering experience</li> <li>Genuine, daily, hands-on fluency with modern AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, or similar) — real power-user experience, not occasional use</li> <li>Experience building and shipping internal tools or developer-facing automation</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication and internal advocacy skills — comfortable teaching, writing, and influencing engineers at very different comfort levels with AI tooling</li> <li>A balanced approach — trying to get people to use AI effectively and safely where appropriate. We don't have an 'AI mandate'; we believe that if we make AI both easy to use and safe, people will choose to use it when appropriate.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity and self-directed prioritization on a small, still-forming team</li> <li>Product or systems thinking — able to identify and prioritize high-leverage opportunities, not just execute a pre-set roadmap</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to Have</h3> <ul> <li>Prior experience in developer experience, platform engineering, or internal tooling</li> <li>Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLMs and coding agents</li> <li>Experience with a systems language such as Go or Rust, in addition to Python</li> <li>Background in security or code-review practices — helpful for reasoning about AI/agent-generated code, though you don't need to be a security engineer</li> <li>Experience in developer relations, technical evangelism, or customer-facing developer advocacy — the same skills that make someone effective in external DevRel translate well to driving internal AI adoption</li> <li>Technical project management experience</li> </ul> <p>As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">UK Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£128,770</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£178,540 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self.</strong> We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.</li> <li><strong>A competitive total compensation package.</strong> This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).</li> <li><strong>Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. </strong>Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!</li> <li><strong>Remote first company</strong>—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.</li> <li><strong>Employer-funded retirement contributions. </strong>Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.</li> <li><strong>Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. </strong>Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.<strong><br></strong></li> <li><strong>Support for your personal and professional development.</strong> Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. </li> <li><strong>Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. </strong>Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world! </li> <li><strong>A build-your-own home office setup. </strong>You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own. </li> <li><strong>Paid parental leave program</strong>. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).</li> </ul> <p><em>Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. title: Senior Full Stack Developer | Java / React (f/m/d)
description: Become a Part of ACCURIDS Join us and help shape the future of pharmaceutical data! We help global life-science companies launch products faster, more safely, and with better patient outcomes. At ACCURIDS, you’ll join a collaborative, growth-driven environment where your work makes a real impact from day one. As a key member of our Product Development team, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy while collaborating closely with backend and frontend engineers, QA, DevOps, and product owners. In this role, you will directly align with cross-functional engineering stakeholders and indirectly impact our customers through the features and fixes you deliver, while having direct access to our CTO as a trusted mentor and technical sparring partner How you’ll make an impact: Own features end-to-end: Take full ownership of user-facing features across the stack, from refining business logic in modern Java/Spring Boot to building responsive React/TypeScript interfaces via GraphQL and REST APIs. Amplify velocity with AI: Lead by example in our AI-native engineering culture. You will use tools like Cursor, Claude, or Gemini to accelerate scaffolding, refactoring, and test writing, while acting as the ultimate authority on architectural integrity, security, and quality. As agents take on more of the routine coding, your leverage moves up a level - you direct them, shape the architecture, and own the quality of what ships. Shape next-gen architecture: Drive our evolution toward a multi-module Spring Modulith architecture, optimize complex PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch queries, and dive into domain-specific RDF semantic data structures. Elevate quality & team standards: Raise the bar on engineering hygiene by maintaining rigorous test coverage (JUnit, Testcontainers, Playwright), conducting sharp merge request reviews (including AI-generated code), and mentoring junior engineers. What helps you succeed: Proven SaaS Experience: 5+ years of shipping and owning full-stack features in production software. A degree in Computer Science, Fachinformatiker training, or strong hands-on experience as a career-changer are all welcome. AI-Native Mindset: AI tools (Cursor, Claude and Gemini) are an integral part of your daily workflow. You view AI as an output amplifier, combine high curiosity with deep technical judgment, and reject skepticism toward AI-assisted coding. Location & Work Permit: You are based in Germany within a reasonable commuting distance to our Cologne office (NRW) and hold a valid German work permit. Full-Stack Core Stack: Deep expertise in modern Java (17+), the Spring Boot ecosystem (Spring Security, Spring Data JPA), React 18, TypeScript, Redux, and GraphQL (Apollo Client). Data & Testing Rigor: Strong hands-on experience with SQL/PostgreSQL, Flyway migrations, full-stack testing (Unit, Integration, E2E), and GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Languages: Business fluent English is required; German skills are a strong plus. Bonus Impact: Prior experience with semantic web tools (RDF, SPARQL, Apache Jena), Material UI (MUI 5), Elasticsearch, or pharma/life-sciences domains (FHIR, IDMP) is a major plus. Why you’ll love working here: Impactful Career Growth: Evolve into a Technical Lead / Lead Engineer role or deepen your specialization in semantic data platforms, AI features, or platform architecture as we scale. Epic Office & Hybrid Work: Work from our brand-new office in the KölnTurm, featuring breathtaking views over the city (even higher than the view from the Cologne Cathedral!). Enjoy flexible hybrid options. (Note: On-site presence in Cologne/NRW is required; fully remote work is not offered). Community & Industry Events: Connect and grow your network through exclusive industry events hosted regularly right in our scenic office space. Competitive Compensation: Fixed salary package of €75,000 – €100,000 per year for a full-time, permanent position. Work-Life Balance & Perks: 30 days of paid vacation, a personal learning budget, hardware of your choice (Mac, Linux, Windows), and your choice between a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership or a €50/month City Plus Card. Empowered Culture: High trust, flat hierarchies, and an environment where your decisions directly shape the product. Not ticking every box? Not ticking every box? We encourage you to apply anyway! We know great talent doesn’t always follow a checklist and we care more about your potential, curiosity, and motivation to learn. At ACCURIDS, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially encourage women and people from underrepresented backgrounds in tech, science, and data to apply. title: CTO / Technical Co-Founder (f/m/d) role at startup METAKI
description: **METAKI **Dresden, Germany (TU Dresden) | On-site / Hybrid | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / AI for Engineering **About Metaki **Metaki is building a 'Large Engineering Model' (LEM): a graph-neural-network surrogate trained on large-scale finite element simulation (FEA) data that predicts, near-instantly, how complex 3D parts respond to different materials, loads and boundary conditions — replacing slow FEA runs. The initial focus is solid and structural mechanics, with the long-term ambition of a general foundation model for engineering physics. **The opportunity **Founded by Samir El Masri (Founder, ongoing PhD in FEM, 3 years of industry experience in FEM & AI/ML for engineering), Metaki already has a working FEM → data → NN pipeline, is building out a large 3D training dataset, and is running training alongside early industry discussions. What's missing is a technical co-founder to help scale the modeling and engineering work while Samir also drives funding applications and industrial pilot partnerships. Tasks **What you will own ** **Model & platform development **- Co-own the neural-network surrogate modeling pipeline (FEM data → GNN training → fast inference), extending it from solid/structural mechanics towards a general engineering-physics foundation model. - Scale the large 3D simulation dataset and physics-informed training infrastructure currently in development. **Technical leadership **- Take technical/CTO ownership alongside Samir El Masri (Founder), covering architecture, ML engineering and data pipeline decisions. - Help turn early industry discussions into validated industrial pilots by making the model production-ready. **Fundraising support **- Support funding applications and strategic introductions with a credible technical narrative and roadmap. Requirements **What you bring ** **Core experience **- Strong machine learning background, ideally with graph neural networks, surrogate modeling, or physics-informed ML. - Comfort working with finite element simulation data and engineering/physics domain concepts (solid or structural mechanics a plus). **Especially valuable **- Software/ML engineering experience taking a research pipeline to a scalable, production-ready product. - Interest in building toward a general foundation model for engineering physics. - Experience with industrial pilot partnerships or applied research collaborations. Benefits **Why join Metaki **- A working FEM → data → NN pipeline already built, not just an idea — real technical traction to build on. - Early industry discussions already underway, with funding applications and pilot partnerships actively being pursued. - Ground-floor technical co-founder equity in a company aiming to become a foundational-model platform for engineering physics. Metaki welcomes co-founder candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, sexual identity, or any other characteristic. This is a search for the right partner to build the company with, not a conventional hire. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior ML Ops Engineer
description: KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business. As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. Every machine learning model KAYAK ships depends on reliable, scalable infrastructure to move from experiment to production — and that's exactly what this role makes possible. KAYAK is seeking a Senior MLOps Engineer who will focus on the design and implementation of our machine learning infrastructure and production lifecycle. This is a senior, hands-on role where you will bridge the gap between data science and production engineering. You will join the Machine Learning Platform team and be responsible for building and maintaining scalable infrastructure & automated pipelines for model training, deployment, and monitoring, ensuring our ML models are reliable, reproducible, and performant. You will work closely with Data Scientists, ML Engineering and Operations teams to transform experimental code into robust, production-ready services at scale. This role requires commuting to the Berlin office 3 times a week. In this role, you will: Build and maintain ML infrastructure end-to-end: Extend and operate the infrastructure that powers every model we ship — including CI/CD pipelines, model orchestration, and automated training pipelines designed to scale reliably without manual intervention. Own model deployment and serving: Help define and evolve the standards and tooling for model serving, ensuring low latency and high availability across our ML services. Develop core MLOps capabilities: Establish and maintain essential infrastructure that functions as reliable, self-service systems for the entire machine learning organization — with a focus on feature stores, model registries, and automated monitoring for performance and data drift. Operationalize infrastructure for the ML team: Collaborate with Operations to enable Kubernetes (k8s) autoscaling and GPU provisioning, turning these into accessible, self-service tools for ML practitioners — including standing up and operating a Kubernetes-based development cluster and taking models from experimentation to GPU-backed production. Improve platform reliability and performance: Partner with Operations to design resilient monitoring using advanced observability tooling. Define service-level objectives and implement automation to reduce manual interventions and improve system reliability. Empower Data Scientists through standardized, optimized workflows: Amplify the impact of the ML team by building clear, well-supported "golden paths" — standardized workflows that streamline the model development lifecycle and let Data Scientists focus on modeling while you handle the infrastructure. Please apply if you have: Experience building and operating ML platforms in production environments. Solid working knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), Linux internals, and model serving at scale. Familiarity with ML lifecycle tooling, including orchestration frameworks, feature stores, model registries, and drift or performance monitoring. Experience owning production systems: defining service-level objectives (SLOs), building observability (for example, using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog), participating in incident response, and diagnosing large-scale failures systematically. You look for opportunities to automate repetitive work rather than absorb it. Comfort writing production-quality code in Python or a comparable language. Experience modernizing production infrastructure with attention to reliability, risk, and cost — including thoughtful sequencing of work to maintain availability and continuity for live systems. The ability to take ownership of technical outcomes, advocate for decisions using data, and communicate clearly in writing and in person — to both technical and non-technical audiences. No meeting Fridays Paid parental leave Paid volunteer time Focus on your career growth: Development Dollars Leadership development Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings Travel Discounts Employee Resource Groups 6 weeks paid vacation + a day off for your birthday Free lunch 2 days per week Pension plan contributions Public transportation subsidies Bike leasing program Monthly social events, Thursday happy hours, sports teams An awesome office in Friedrichshain, Berlin Inclusion At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That's why we're focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here. title: Senior ATE Test Engineer (f/m/d)
description: About us We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects About our technology The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution The Role As a Senior Automated Test Equipment (ATE) Test Engineer, you will own the bring-up and operation of our high-volume 300 mm wafer test infrastructure for electronic-photonic integrated circuits. On a daily basis, you will set up and qualify ATE test cells, develop and debug test programs for DC, RF, and electro-optical device characterization, and drive probe card design with vendors. You will analyze wafer-level data to make pass/fail calls and share insights with design and process teams, helping us scale from engineering characterization to high-volume production. To join our team, you should be excited to: Set up, qualify, and calibrate ATE test cells, ensuring readiness for high-volume wafer testing. Develop and debug automated test programs for DC, RF, optical, and electro-optical device characterization, including new measurement methods. Own probe card specifications, design, qualification, and integration, alongside associated interface hardware, in collaboration with vendors. Collaborate across teams to define comprehensive measurement plans and contribute to design-for-test (DFT) implementation. Collect, analyze, and report wafer-level measurement data to determine pass/fail outcomes and support yield monitoring, reliability testing, and failure analysis. Transfer laboratory characterization methods into production, developing automated test protocols and equipment specifications for manufacturing integration. Optimize test throughput while maintaining measurement accuracy and reliability. Work with manufacturing engineering to implement statistical process control (SPC), improve yield, and strengthen test efficiency and data analytics. Support supplier qualification, vendor evaluation, and incoming material characterization. Create test documentation and training materials, ensuring procedures meet industry standards and customer quality requirements. Your Qualifications Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline. At least five years of hands-on experience setting up and operating ATE systems, including wafer probers and probe card specification, qualification, and integration. Strong programming skills in Java and Python for test automation, instrument control, and automated data collection. Hands-on experience performing electrical, optical, and electro-optical measurements on EIC and PIC devices; RF or high-speed testing experience is a plus. A sound understanding of PIC and/or EIC device structures and operation, including EIC-to-PIC interface architectures. Practical knowledge of design-for-test (DFT) methodologies and their implementation in integrated circuits. A proven track record of transferring laboratory test methods and device characterization into production environments. Proficiency in data processing, statistical analysis, and visualization using Python, Java, or LabVIEW, with experience applying statistical process control (SPC) and monitoring yield, process performance, and reliability. Knowledge of supplier management, incoming material characterization, and vendor qualification processes. Experience in a fast-paced startup or semiconductor manufacturing environment is preferred. Advanced knowledge of optoelectronic device physics, graphene-based devices, and semiconductor operating principles is an advantage. Familiarity with photonic component qualification methodologies and industry reliability testing standards is a plus. Experience characterizing and testing optoelectronic or semiconductor packaging is an advantage. Our work culture People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. title: Lead Talent Acquisition EMEA
description: About Pelico Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor. We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones. Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started. This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside. What You’ll Do Shape the talent strategy for EMEA Build our EMEA recruiting strategy from the ground up: the processes, playbooks, and operating rhythm that let us scale hiring with quality. Raise talent quality and density: define what great looks like for each role, coach hiring managers on how to spot and hire the right people, and track quality of hire. Partner with People leadership on a data-driven talent strategy, using funnel metrics and market insights to forecast needs and influence hiring decisions. Create our EMEA employer brand strategy, from job sites and career page to school partnerships and events, with a great candidate experience at every step. Stay hands-on: recruit every day Own full-cycle recruiting from kickoff through offer acceptance, with a focus on tech roles and support on select business hires. Run creative, outbound-first sourcing and build talent pipelines before needs become urgent. Advise hiring managers on candidate profiles, interview design, and calibration. Build a TA function powered by AI Embed AI across sourcing, market research, candidate engagement, and recruiting operations, and keep testing new ways of working. Set up the tools and ATS (Ashby) that let the team scale. About You AI-powered and innovative You design recruiting processes where AI does the heavy lifting, and you know when to automate and when to keep the human touch. You’re resourceful and curious, and you bring ideas to the team rather than waiting to be asked. 6+ years of tech recruiting experience You have a proven track record hiring tech profiles (engineering, data, product) through full-cycle recruiting. You’re comfortable as a generalist, hiring across functions and seniority levels as needs evolve. You’re skilled at outbound sourcing and experienced with modern ATS platforms. Scale-up and agile mindset You’ve worked in a high-growth, fast-changing environment and love building from zero. You think like an owner, balancing speed with quality. You influence leaders with sound judgment and a genuine care for candidate experience. Nice to have International recruiting experience across multiple markets. Experience managing or mentoring recruiters. Why Pelico We're building something genuinely hard and genuinely important. Here's what that comes with: Meaningful equity - you're building this with us, so you'll own a piece of it Competitive salary benchmarked to your market Flexible, hybrid work model - we care about output, not face time Health, dental, and vision coverage Learning & development budget - we invest in people who invest in themselves Opportunity to work with some of the world's most complex and fascinating manufacturing operations A team that takes the work seriously without taking themselves too seriously Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Internships 2027
description: About Nabla We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine. Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day. We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows. Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere. This is a great time to join us! Early Careers: Software Engineering & Machine Learning We’re looking for early-career engineers who want to learn fast, work with experienced mentors, and make a real impact from day one. You’ll join a collaborative, mission-driven team where technical curiosity and humility matter as much as skill. Location: Paris (Hybrid) Start Date: 2027 (or as early as possible) Commitment: Internship-to-hire What we Offer Real Impact from Day One: You won’t be stuck with small tasks: you’ll contribute to real features and products. Learning Everywhere: We believe in mentorship, pair programming, and leveling up together. Lean, Ambitious Team: Be part of a fast-moving, deeply technical culture where your contributions matter. Healthcare Mission: Help doctors, nurses, and care teams spend more time with Patients Career Launchpad: Many interns convert to full-time, and early engineers grow quickly. We work across multiple domains: Apps: Web app, frontend logic, UI/UX Platform: Backend services, infrastructure, APIs Core (ML): Algorithms, models, data systems Your DNA Currently pursuing or recently graduated in Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math, or a related field . Comfortable coding in at least one: Java, Kotlin, Python, or TypeScript . Passionate about AI, data, or building meaningful product features. Curious, collaborative, and excited to learn. Humble and resilient — you ask questions, take feedback, and grow. Nice-to-Haves (but not required) Internship or personal projects in AI, full-stack, or backend systems. Experience with React, GraphQL, or cloud infrastructure. Knowledge of CI/CD, Docker, or automated testing. You’ll see us on campus at: Télécom Paris Forum Trium ENSIMAG CentraleSupélec École Polytechnique EPFL Forum Organisation Meet us there and tell us what excites you. Life at Nabla When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed. We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes. We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts! If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application! Every day is a new chance to excel We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day. Stay humble There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture. Feedback is a gift We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions. Committed to diversity We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work. Diversity & Inclusion Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond. As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive. Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed There is an active employment scam which is now using Nabla to collect personal information or financial scams. title: Principal Project Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Curious Minds. Bold Ideas. Extraordinary Impact</strong>.<br><br>We're transforming financial services through bold innovation and relentless execution. You bring the ideas and drive. We'll build what's next — together.</p></div><p><strong>Job Summary</strong></p> <p>As a Project Manager, you will be part of a high-performing professional services team focused on evaluating how the nCino product can best meet our European clients’ needs and working with the Implementation Consultant to oversee the application of a seven-step implementation process with nCino bank and credit union customers.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Execute strategic vision and adoption of nCino across financial institutions by engaging stakeholders at all levels. Foster strong relationships and ensure alignment with organizational goals for project success. </li> <li>Take full ownership of the project/program timeline, proactively addressing risks and dependencies. Implement strategies to keep deliverables on track and ensure timely completion of milestones. </li> <li>Leads cross-functional teams using Agile methodologies, ensuring efficient delivery of projects by facilitating sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and ensuring continuous improvement throughout the development lifecycle. </li> <li>Oversees large-scale implementations by managing multiple workstreams, ensuring alignment across teams, mitigating risks, and maintaining project timelines to deliver successful, integrated solutions on time and within budget </li> <li>Manages stakeholder relationships by ensuring clear communication, expectations alignment, and regular updates; oversees resource allocation to optimize team performance and capacity; tracks budget and burn rates to ensure projects stay within financial constraints; and monitors key performance indicators (KPIs) and business value metrics (BVMs) to assess progress, drive decision-making, and ensure delivery of high-impact outcomes </li> <li>Independently handle project escalations, maintaining momentum and customer satisfaction. Swiftly address challenges and implement effective problem-solving strategies. </li> <li>Exhibit advanced skills in managing nCino project plans and tooling, including task management, resource coordination, and milestone achievement. Ensure alignment with strategic objectives and timely, budget-compliant deliverables. </li> <li>Provide comprehensive project status updates and risk assessments to peers and senior management. Ensure transparent communication across all stakeholders, enhancing project visibility and confidence. </li> <li>Seek knowledge, refine domain skills, and work collaboratively for team success. Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional growth, developing advanced technical skills. </li> <li>Mentor new employees, interact with leaders across departments, and be sought out for opinions on significant matters. Lead by example, driving organizational excellence and contributing to the refinement of internal processes and tools within our teams. </li> <li>Proactively identify and capitalize on whitespace within programs to drive revenue for nCino. This includes assessing additional resourcing needs, exploring cross-sell/up-sell opportunities, and negotiating higher rates based on the value provided by current resources. </li> <li>Leverage AI tools and techniques to enhance work efficiency and optimize business operations by automating routine tasks to improve accuracy, save time, and minimize errors.</li> <li>Utilize AI-driven insights to refine decision-making, elevate customer experience, and boost team productivity while ensuring its application provides measurable value, driving innovation and smarter ways of working.</li> <li>Stay informed on AI advancements to drive continuous learning and scalable growth opportunities.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <p>Required:</p> <ul> <li>Undergraduate degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business, Management, Information Technology) or equivalent experience. </li> <li>8+ years of professional experience in project management or a related field. </li> <li>Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). </li> <li>Proven ability to manage complex tasks with precision, leveraging strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills. </li> <li>Communicates effectively across all levels, translating complex information into clear, audience-appropriate messaging. </li> <li>Successfully leads projects with minimal oversight, demonstrating initiative while appropriately escalating issues when needed. </li> <li>Builds credibility and influence through transparent communication, collaborative engagement, and consistent follow-through. </li> <li>Actively supports organizational change by identifying opportunities for improvement and constructively challenging existing processes. </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>Desired:<strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li>Salesforce experience </li> <li>nCino experience (as an end user or nCino implementation)  </li> <li>PMP/PMI certification preferred </li> <li>Position may require travel </li> <li>Previous project management experience </li> <li>Background in multiple lines of business in banking </li> <li>Familiarity with agile software delivery practices and concepts<br> </li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The pay range for this role is based on relative market data and alignment with our title: Senior Network Engineer – Deployment
description: <p>.</p> <h2><strong>About Nscale</strong></h2> <p>Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.</p> <p>We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We're looking for a Senior Network Engineer to build and bring up the networks behind Nscale's GPU clusters across Europe. You'll join our Deployment organisation, a build org that owns every step from hardware arrival on site through to customer acceptance.</p> <p>This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll take network designs into production: configuring and validating cluster fabrics, front-end networks, and WAN edge, troubleshooting issues during bring-up, and making sure every build is ready for customers. The role involves regular travel to our sites.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll be Doing</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Deploy, configure, and validate high-performance Ethernet and InfiniBand fabrics for large GPU clusters.</li> <li>Bring up front-end, storage, and management networks and WAN edge connectivity for new sites and expansions.</li> <li>Run network acceptance testing and performance validation ahead of customer handover.</li> <li>Troubleshoot and resolve issues across routing, switching, optics, and cabling during build and early life.</li> <li>Work with Network Architecture to refine reference designs, BOMs, and build standards based on what you learn in the field.</li> <li>Build and improve automation for provisioning, configuration, and validation.</li> <li>Partner with Technical Program Managers, Data Centre Operations, and vendors to keep builds on schedule.</li> <li>Write clear runbooks and documentation so builds are repeatable across sites.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About You</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of network engineering experience in large-scale data centre, cloud, or HPC environments.</li> <li>Experience at a hyperscaler or major network vendor (e.g. Microsoft, AWS, Oracle/OCI, Cisco) or a comparable large-scale network.</li> <li>Strong hands-on knowledge of routing and switching: BGP, OSPF, EVPN/VXLAN, ECMP, and L2/L3 data centre design.</li> <li>Experience deploying and operating cluster networks, ideally including InfiniBand or RoCE fabrics.</li> <li>Practical experience with network automation (Python, Ansible, or similar).</li> <li>Calm, methodical troubleshooter who can work under deadline pressure on live builds.</li> <li>Willingness to travel across Europe to sites as needed.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience building networks for GPU clusters or AI training environments.</li> <li>Familiarity with HPC topologies (Fat Tree, Rail) and 400G/800G optics.</li> <li>Experience with SONiC, Cumulus, or other open networking platforms.</li> <li>WAN, peering, or DWDM experience.</li> <li>Industry certifications such as CCNP/CCIE, JNCIP/JNCIE, or NVIDIA networking certifications.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why this role matters</strong></h2> <p>The network is what turns thousands of GPUs into a single system. Your work decides how fast new clusters reach customers and how well they perform once they do.</p> <h2><strong>Equal Opportunities Statement</strong></h2> <p>At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.</p> <p>If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.</p> <p>The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of the position. The employee may be required to perform additional duties, tasks, and responsibilities as assigned by management, consistent with the skills and qualifications required for the role.</p> <p><em>Internal only (do not post): Hiring manager Vijay Kanchanahalli · Location Europe (any country with an Nscale entity) · Proposed level L5 · Workday job family Network Engineering – Network Engineering · Based on GH reqs 1357 and 901 (both job posts were placeholders, so content draws on Vijay's hiring profile and the Director/PPM posts).</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee & Candidate Privacy Notice: <a href="https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QK5Yg04WHD9K9IAtJgQWubJZC9oLvatK/view?usp=sharing" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QK5Yg04WHD9K9IAtJgQWubJZC9oLvatK/view?usp%3Dsharing&source=gmail&ust=1765375172804000&usg=AOvVaw2Ncte4rmlGl8OKuFuDgDtx">Here.</a><br><br>Nscale does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from recruitment agencies.<br></em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Director, Low Voltage/Fiber Deployment EMEA
description: <p><em><strong>Please note this role will require regular travel to sites across EMEA, including the Nordics, and can be based from either the United Kingdom or Ireland.</strong></em></p> <p> </p> <p>Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.</p> <p>We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>The Director of LV/Fiber Deployment leads the planning, execution, and operational handoff of low-voltage and fiber infrastructure deployments across data center, edge, and network facilities. This leader ensures deployments are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to defined quality and reliability standards.</p> <p>The role owns the end-to-end deployment lifecycle: design coordination, vendor strategy, material readiness, field execution, commissioning support, documentation, and turnover to operations.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll be Doing</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead regional or global deployment programs for structured cabling, fiber backbone, low-voltage systems, and related physical infrastructure.</li> <li>Build and lead a high-performing team of deployment managers, program managers, field engineers, and vendor partners.</li> <li>Own deployment planning, schedules, resource models, budgets, forecasts, and executive reporting.</li> <li>Partner with design, construction, network engineering, data center operations, supply chain, security, and commissioning teams to deliver production-ready infrastructure.</li> <li>Establish standardized deployment playbooks, quality controls, acceptance criteria, and turnover processes.</li> <li>Manage installation partners and vendors, including selection, performance management, capacity planning, safety, quality, and commercial accountability.</li> <li>Drive deployment readiness by ensuring materials, labor, site access, permits, test equipment, and documentation are available ahead of execution.</li> <li>Oversee fiber testing, labeling, documentation, as-built records, cable management, and remediation of quality issues.</li> <li>Lead complex retrofits and live-site deployments while protecting customer availability, safety, and operational continuity.</li> <li>Define and improve deployment KPIs, including on-time delivery, first-pass quality, cost per deployment, defect rates, safety performance, and time-to-service.</li> <li>Identify deployment risks early, remove execution blockers, and lead escalation paths across internal and external stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in physical infrastructure deployment, data centers, telecommunications, network construction, or large-scale critical environments.</li> <li>5+ years leading multi-site teams, contractors, vendors, or complex deployment programs.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of structured cabling, fiber-optic infrastructure, low-voltage systems, testing and certification practices, and cable-management standards.</li> <li>Experience delivering infrastructure in data centers, telecom networks, industrial facilities, or other mission-critical environments.</li> <li>Demonstrated success managing large vendor workforces, budgets, schedules, and quality programs.</li> <li>Strong understanding of construction, commissioning, change control, site readiness, and operational handoff.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead safely in live production environments and balance speed, quality, cost, and availability.</li> <li>Excellent executive communication, cross-functional leadership, and problem-solving skills.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Preferred Qualifications and Experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience supporting hyperscale cloud, AI/GPU infrastructure, or high-density data center deployments.</li> <li>Experience with fiber design, OTDR testing, splice management, MPO/MTP systems, and structured-cabling standards.</li> <li>Familiarity with BICSI, TIA/EIA, ISO/IEC, and applicable local codes and safety requirements.</li> <li>Experience with deployment tooling, asset tracking, work-order systems, and dashboard-driven operational management.</li> <li>Relevant certifications such as RCDD, CFOT, PMP, or Lean/Six Sigma.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Success Measures</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Safe, on-time, and on-budget title: Principal Solutions Architect
description: <h2 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">About Nscale</h2> <p>Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.</p> <p>We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are hiring a <strong>Principal Solution Architect</strong> to design and deliver end-to-end GPU infrastructure solutions that power some of the world's most demanding AI workloads.</p> <p>This is a highly technical, customer-facing role at the intersection of AI infrastructure, solution architecture, and engineering. You will translate complex customer requirements into scalable, high-performance infrastructure designs spanning GPU compute, networking, storage, data centre systems, and orchestration platforms.</p> <p>You'll own solution designs end-to-end, from bare-metal GPU fabrics and high-performance networking through to the orchestration layers customers use to run their AI workloads. You'll also leverage modern AI tooling and automation to accelerate solution design, architecture validation, and deployment readiness.</p> <p>Working closely with customers and Nscale's Engineering, Infrastructure, and Deployment teams, you'll act as a trusted technical advisor, ensuring our solutions deliver exceptional performance, reliability, and scalability.</p> <h2>What you'll be doing</h2> <h3>GPU Infrastructure & Solution Architecture</h3> <ul data-spread="false"> <li> <p>Design end-to-end GPU infrastructure solutions tailored to customer requirements and AI workloads.</p> </li> <li> <p>Architect GPU cluster configurations, including rack layouts, power and cooling considerations, and NVLink/NVSwitch domains.</p> </li> <li> <p>Design high-performance network architectures, including leaf/spine, rail-optimised fabrics, InfiniBand, Ethernet, RoCE, and GPUDirect RDMA.</p> </li> <li> <p>Define storage architectures and data pipelines supporting large-scale AI training and inference workloads.</p> </li> <li> <p>Design infrastructure and orchestration layers, including bare-metal provisioning, Kubernetes, Slurm, and multi-tenant scheduling.</p> </li> <li> <p>Architect control plane and management systems covering monitoring, alerting, and cluster lifecycle management.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Customer Engagement & Technical Advisory</h3> <ul data-spread="false"> <li> <p>Engage directly with customers to understand their technical requirements, workloads, and infrastructure challenges.</p> </li> <li> <p>Translate customer needs into detailed technical architectures, specifications, and reference designs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Act as a trusted technical advisor, guiding customers through infrastructure design decisions and technical trade-offs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Collaborate with internal Engineering teams to ensure proposed solutions are technically feasible, scalable, and aligned with Nscale's infrastructure capabilities.</p> </li> <li> <p>Support deployment planning and ensure solutions meet agreed performance, reliability, and operational requirements.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>GPU Performance, Testing & Validation</h3> <ul data-spread="false"> <li> <p>Define and execute infrastructure acceptance and validation plans for GPU clusters.</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead performance benchmarking using NCCL collectives and other GPU performance testing tools.</p> </li> <li> <p>Validate network fabrics, GPU interconnects, and cluster configurations to ensure optimal performance.</p> </li> <li> <p>Troubleshoot multi-node GPU performance issues, including degraded links, fabric misconfigurations, stragglers, and performance regressions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Establish performance acceptance criteria and support GPU infrastructure sign-off before production deployment.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>AI-Driven Design & Infrastructure Automation</h3> <ul data-spread="false"> <li> <p>Leverage AI tooling to automate and accelerate infrastructure design and engineering workflows.</p> </li> <li> <p>Develop automated approaches for generating and iterating on architectures, bills of materials (BoMs), network topologies, and deployment artefacts.</p> </li> <li> <p>Apply LLM-assisted engineering, code generation, and agentic workflows to improve design efficiency and accuracy.</p> </li> <li> <p>Use Infrastructure-as-Code and scripting tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Python, or Go to streamline infrastructure design and deployment.</p> </li> <li> <p>Identify opportunities to improve repeatability, consistency, and scalability across solution architecture processes.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Storage, Reliability & Operational Readiness</h3> <ul data-spread="false"> <li> <p>Design storage solutions optimised for AI workloads, including parallel and distributed file systems.</p> </li> <li> <p>Consider data throughput, checkpointing, and storage performance requirements when designing GPU clusters.</p> </li> <li> <p>Incorporate reliability, availability, and serviceability principles into infrastructure architectures.</p> </li> <li> <p>Define monitoring, health checks, observability, and diagnostic requirements for production environments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with Infrastructure and Operations teams to ensure successful deployment, validation, and ongoing operational readiness.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Technology Research & Continuous Improvement</h3> <ul data-spread="false"> <li> <p>Stay current with emerging GPU technologies, networking architectures, storage platforms, and AI infrastructure innovations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Research and evaluate new technologies to inform Nscale's future solution architectures.</p> </li> <li> <p>Contribute to the development of reusable reference architectures, engineering standards, and technical best practices.</p> </li> <li> <p>Share technical knowledge and expertise across Engineering, Product, and customer-facing teams.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>About You</h2> <h3>Required Experience</h3> <ul data-spread="false"> <li> <p>10+ years of relevant experience in solution architecture, infrastructure ability to translate complex customer requirements into detailed technical architectures and implementation plans.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure and performance challenges.</p> </li> <li> <p>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and Wir ermöglichen es EV-Besitzer:innen, ihr Fahrzeug innerhalb von 48 Stunden zu verkaufen, und verschaffen Händlern in ganz Europa Zugang zu neuen Kundensegmenten. Der Markt ist fragmentiert, intransparent und schwer vertrauenswürdig, deshalb bauen wir die Infrastruktur, die das ändert, damit mehr Elektroautos ein zweites Leben bekommen und der Wandel zur Elektromobilität wirklich an Fahrt aufnimmt. Und es funktioniert: Wir steigern unseren Umsatz Jahr für Jahr um das Vierfache und halten bereits mehr als 1 % des deutschen Consumer-EV-Wiederverkaufsmarkts. Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene und der Automobilwelt, mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Alasco, Porsche, Mercedes und KPMG. Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen. Wenn du etwas bewegen möchtest, dann werde Teil unseres Teams. Deine Mission Du hast Lust auf direkten Kundenkontakt, gehst gerne auf Menschen zu und Autos sind für dich nicht einfach nur Fortbewegungsmittel, sondern ein echtes Interesse? Dann bist du bei uns im Sales Team genau richtig. Operativer Vertrieb: Du unterstützt unser Sales Team dabei, Fahrzeuge für die Auktion vorzubereiten: von der Prüfung der Daten bis hin zur finalen Aufbereitung für die Plattform. Prozessbegleitung: Du begleitest unsere Verkäufer:innen durch den gesamten Verkaufsprozess. Vom ersten telefonischen Kontakt bis zur Planung der Übergabe sorgst du dafür, dass intern alles reibungslos läuft. Sales-Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe, bringst Ideen ein und hilfst mit, unsere Prozesse schlanker, effizienter und skalierbarer zu gestalten. Feedback für Produkt und Team: Du gibst Erkenntnisse aus dem Kundenkontakt weiter und hilfst so, unser Produkt gezielt weiterzuentwickeln. Startup-Alltag: Du bringst dich dort ein, wo du gebraucht wirst, mit deinen individuellen Stärken und Interessen. Das bringst du mit Dein Background: Du bist aktuell immatrikuliert im Bachelor- oder Masterstudium. Dein Studiengang ist für uns zweitrangig, viel wichtiger sind deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und dein Blick für saubere Prozesse. Kommunikationsstärke: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, telefonierst gerne und fühlst dich im direkten Kundenkontakt wohl. Interesse an Autos: Kein Muss, aber definitiv ein Plus, denn du wirst viel mit Fahrzeugdaten arbeiten. Entrepreneurial Mindset: Du hast Lust auf ein Umfeld, in dem sich Dinge schnell bewegen, zeigst Eigeninitiative und willst aktiv mitgestalten statt nur Dienst nach Vorschrift zu leisten. Verfügbarkeit: Du hast 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit für uns, in den Semesterferien gerne mehr. Sprachkenntnisse: Du beherrschst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) und Englisch sicher in Wort und Schrift. Why Aampere? Wachstum & Ownership: Du bekommst vom ersten Tag an echte Verantwortung, triffst eigene Entscheidungen und wirst als vollwertiges Teammitglied behandelt: im schnelllebigen Umfeld kannst du entsprechend schnell aufsteigen. Student steht auf dem Vertrag, nicht auf deiner Rolle. Urban Sports Club oder Job Ticket: healthy team, happy team Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats) Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what's next? Wohnen im Werksviertel: Im angrenzenden Co-Living Space gibt es die Möglichkeit, eigenständig ein Zimmer zu mieten: direkt neben dem Aampere-Büro und mit Blick auf das Riesenrad. Chance auf Übernahme : Wenn du besonders gut bist, wollen wir, dass du bleibst. Denk von Anfang an nicht daran, wo das endet, sondern wo es hinführen könnte. Aampere ist nichts für dich wenn... ...du überwiegend remote arbeiten willst. Wir glauben, dass die besten Ideen entstehen, wenn Menschen im selben Raum sind. ...du fertige Prozesse und Strukturen vorfinden willst. Bei uns gibt es vieles davon noch nicht. Wir suchen Leute, die Strukturen und Prozesse selbst bauen, statt sie zu verwalten. ...du einen fertigen Plan brauchst, bevor du loslegst. Seed Stage heißt: vieles ist unklar und ändert sich wöchentlich. Du musst dich wohl damit fühlen, im Ungewissen zu entscheiden und unterwegs zu korrigieren. ...du in deiner Lane bleiben willst. "Das ist nicht mein Job" kennen wir nicht. Du packst da an, wo es brennt, auch wenn es außerhalb deiner Rollenbeschreibung liegt. ...du einen klassischen 9-to-5-Job willst. Wir bauen etwas Großes und das geht nicht nebenbei. Wer hier ist, will Vollgas geben, statt nur die Zeit abzusitzen. Wie wir arbeiten Drei Werte, keine Poster an der Wand, sondern wie wir täglich arbeiten, einstellen und wachsen: Aaudacity. Wir sind mutig genug, Risiken einzugehen, und schnell genug, es nicht halbherzig zu tun. Aambition to grow. Wir wollen wachsen, als Menschen und als Unternehmen. Aampact over Hierarchy. Die beste Idee gewinnt, egal von wem sie kommt. Titel entscheiden hier keine Diskussion. Noch ein paar Worte zum Abschluss Bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns über Deine formlose Bewerbung - alles weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam. Egal, welchen Hintergrund, welche Herkunft oder welche Geschlechtsidentität du mitbringst – bei uns zählt, wer du als Person bist. Wir fördern eine Kultur des Respekts und Miteinanders, in der jede Stimme gehört wird, persönliche Weiterentwicklung möglich ist und Wertschätzung an erster Stelle steht. title: Product Manager (m/f/d) - For Relentlessly Ambitious People
description: Your mission This is not a normal job. Please read this part before you read anything else. If you are highly driven, extremely ambitious, and you want to do the work of your life at a company that will change how people get access to new therapies and shared medical knowledge, mama health is the place for you. If not, this role is not for you. This is why: You will be in the office 5 days a week. Berlin HQ. Not hybrid. Not "flexible". We build together, in the same room, every day. You will work a lot. More than at most jobs. We do not count hours, we count what we ship and what it changes for patients. You will give some of the best years of your life to this. In return, you get ownership, speed, and a problem worth your time. You will get obsessed with metrics. Not dashboards for a weekly meeting. Real obsession: why did this number move, what does it mean for a patient, what do we change tomorrow. Why do we ask this much? Because today, patients spend years to reach the right therapy. We want to help every patient reach their best possible care faster: understand their own situation, get clear information about it, and get access to the best tools, therapies, and treatments in the world. This is generational work not work for everyone. It will change your life and the lives of millions of other people. This role is built to grow into Head of Product. How fast depends on you. - - - - - As a Product Manager at mama health, you will shape and execute product of one of the most exciting AI companies in healthcare. You will work closely with the founders, engineers, designers, and medical experts to build products that help patients understand their diseases, and that help healthcare organizations learn directly from patient experiences at scale. This is an execution role. You will be expected to take ownership, turn ambitious goals into shipped products, and keep a high pace. You will be responsible for driving product development from idea to launch while ensuring alignment across teams and maintaining a high pace of execution. You will: Own product initiatives from discovery to delivery and iteration Write your own SQL queries, build your own analyses, and find the "why" behind every metric Define success metrics for everything you ship, and own the result Translate company goals into clear priorities, roadmaps, and execution plans Work closely with engineering, design, AI, and medical teams to ship high-quality products on time Drive day-to-day execution, remove blockers, and keep projects on track Talk to patients and customers, and turn what you learn into product improvements Write product requirements and user stories Help build product processes that scale as we grow Your profile 1 to 3 years of experience in a product role (Product Manager, Associate PM, Product Analyst, Product Owner, or a founder who shipped a real product) Hands-on experience with SQL and analytics tools (for example Metabase, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Looker, or similar). You do not wait for a data team to answer your questions. Proof that you ship: products, features, side projects, anything real Highly driven, proactive, and execution-oriented. You do more than people ask. Strong analytical thinking and problem solving You learn fast and you like to be out of your comfort zone Clear communication with engineers, designers, and business people Fluent English is required. German is a nice to have. Experience in AI, healthcare, digital health, or SaaS is a nice to have. Based in Berlin or ready to relocate fast. Why us? A real path to Head of Product. We hire for where you can be in 2 years, not only for where you are today. Ownership from day one. You will not wait for permission to do important work. A mission that matters. Every metric you move is a patient who gets better information, faster. A team that plays hard too. Regular team events, sports benefits, shared learning, and our annual team retreat. When you join our team, you'll be part of a forward-thinking company that values integrity, collaboration and results-driven work. Join us and be part of a mission-driven organization dedicated to improving healthcare outcomes. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Manager (m/w/d) – Core Team
description: Deine Aufgaben Wir bauen die Software, mit der Mieterstromprojekte laufen: Zählerdaten rein, Abrechnung raus, und alles dazwischen. Das Core Team verantwortet das Betreiberportal, das Produkt, auf dem der laufende Betrieb unserer Kunden steht. Es ist unser fachlich tiefstes Team, und es wächst. Das Betreiberportal ist kein generisches SaaS. Es bildet die Energiewirtschaft ab: Messstellenbetrieb, Marktkommunikation, Netzentgelte, Umlagen, Abrechnung nach Regeln, die der Gesetzgeber schreibt und regelmäßig ändert. Wer hier priorisiert, muss verstehen, was eine Anforderung für den Betreiber wirtschaftlich bedeutet und was passiert, wenn sie falsch umgesetzt wird. Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die das Team führt und das Geschäft dahinter versteht. Nicht als Durchreiche für Tickets und nicht als Architekt, der alles selbst entscheidet, sondern als jemand, der Business-Anforderungen in technische Entscheidungen übersetzt und dafür sorgt, dass gute Entwickler gute Arbeit machen können: klare Ziele, wenig Reibung, ehrliches Feedback, verlässliche Lieferung. Der Weg dahin ist bewusst gewählt: Du startest für rund sechs Monate als Entwickler im Core Team. Du baust Features, machst Reviews und lernst Codebasis, Fachlichkeit und Menschen von innen kennen. Danach übernimmst du die Führung des Teams. Wer ein Team führen will, das er nie von innen gesehen hat, führt es an dem vorbei, was zählt.
