title: Platform Security Engineer
description: At Scality, we build software that stores and protects the world’s most critical data — running on Linux, inside some of the largest infrastructures on the planet, at exabyte scale, for organizations that cannot afford to fail. We are looking for a Platform Security Engineer to join our platform and delivery team in Paris. This is a new seat, and it exists because security work needs dedicated capacity. Absorbed as background tasks between feature tickets, it never gets the focus it deserves. You would be that dedicated capacity. This is a Linux-first, hands-on engineering role. You will not write policies for other people to implement — you will write the Python and Bash that hardens our OS, automates our vulnerability management, and proves to auditors and customers that our supply chain is sound. About Scality Scality is the leader in software-defined object storage, trusted by 1,000+ enterprises and 700M+ users worldwide across banking, healthcare, and government sectors — exactly the sectors where security posture is a purchasing criterion, not a checkbox. Industry recognition: Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for 9 consecutive years — the only 100% software-defined storage company to hold this position since the quadrant’s inception #1 on the GigaOm Radar for Enterprise Object Storage (2024), ahead of 17 competing vendors Gold Stevie Award 2025 — ARTESCA 3.0, Cloud Storage & Backup Solution category Net Promoter Score of 85 across RING and ARTESCA About the team You will join a small team of highly skilled Linux engineers responsible for delivering and maintaining ADI (Scality Autonomous Data Infrastructure), our full platform: RING (object storage), S3C (S3-compatible layer), and SCOS (Scality OS — our own Linux distribution). The team works across the full stack of infrastructure engineering — deep Linux system integration, RPM packaging, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and release automation. The command line is where most of our day happens, and we ship a Linux distribution to customers. How We Build We build with AI tools, in earnest rather than as an experiment. Every engineer here has Claude Code, and it is part of how we write, review, and ship code day to day. We are also designing something larger: an AI code and delivery factory — AI woven into the build and release chain itself, not just into the editor. That work is early and still being thought through rather than already solved. We expect it to become part of how we maintain the platform, and CVE remediation is one of the first places we think it fits: an automated path from advisory to assessment to a patched, tested, delivered build. If that sounds like a problem you would want to work on, this role sits close to it. One principle is not negotiable: a human owns the outcome. AI writes code here, and when it does, we own what it produces — the review, the decision to ship, the consequences, and the fix. “The tool did it” is not an explanation we accept from ourselves, and it is not one we would offer a customer. In security work that matters doubly: an answer you cannot defend is worse than no answer at all. How This Role Works Scality is building a network of security engineers across the engineering department — a security peer embedded in each development team, rather than a central security function working at arm’s length from the code. You would be that peer for the platform and delivery team. Security priorities are owned by our VP of Engineering. The agenda is set at that level, with dedicated resources committed across the teams. You will not have to invent it alone — and you will have a voice in it: the engineers closest to the code help decide what goes on the roadmap. We will be straight with you: today security work competes with delivery commitments and too often loses. Naming an owner and funding dedicated people is how we intend to change that. You would help build that capability, not inherit a finished one. The team is accountable for the deliveries. Security items sit on the team’s plate alongside everything else it commits to, rather than in a separate function filing tickets from the outside. You are the dedicated resource that makes them happen. While your teammates carry releases, OS compatibility, and platform features, your time is reserved for the security work. That focus is the whole reason the seat exists. You share the team’s perimeter and its knowledge. Same repositories, same Jira projects, same code reviews, same sprint rituals. The engineers around you have rare, hard-earned Linux depth — OS integration, RPM packaging, boot and GRUB, CI/CD, monitoring — and you will learn the platform from them. You will have peers. Security engineers embedded in the other development teams work the same problems on different perimeters. That network is where you compare notes, share tooling, and grow into the craft. The point of the model is that security decisions get made inside the team that builds and ships the product, by someone who understands the build system rather than filing tickets against it. Your First Missions Two priorities are already on the roadmap, and they will shape your first year. 1. CVE exposure, answered before it is asked Customers in banking, healthcare, and government ask us, routinely and under their own audit obligations, whether our products are exposed to a given CVE. That will not stop — for them, asking is the compliance requirement. Today each answer is researched from scratch: a customer question becomes a ticket, the ticket becomes a hunt through SBOMs, vendor advisories, and our own configuration, and the round trip can take weeks to produce something the team is not fully confident defending. Your first mission is to invert that, so the answer already exists when the question arrives. A standing exposure record , per shipped component and per release: what the SBOM says is present, what the upstream vendor has decided (including “will not fix”, which is common on RHEL 8 and often the real answer), and whether the vulnerable code path is actually reachable in our configuration Reachability over presence. A module shipped and loaded by a distribution default is not the same as a module configured on a live URL. That distinction is the difference between “vulnerable” and “no impact”, and it is where the engineering judgement lives Continuous CVE detection across our repositories, vendored third-party modules, container images, and shipped RPMs Wiring detection into our existing SBOM tooling and GitHub Actions pipelines, so exposure is computed when a release is built rather than when a customer asks A defined interface with the security engineers and the customer-facing teams: who produces the technical assessment, who owns the wording that reaches the customer, and how both meet the response commitments in our customer security policy Durable capture. An assessment that lives only in a ticket comment gets re-derived next release. Findings belong somewhere queryable A remediation loop with clear ownership and response targets, integrated with how the team already works in Jira AI-assisted remediation , where it fits: from advisory to proposed patch to a tested build, with a human deciding what ships Done well, a customer’s “are you affected by X?” becomes a lookup and an afternoon, not an escalation and three weeks. 2. Raising the security baseline of SCOS SCOS is our own Linux distribution — we control the kickstarts, the package set, the boot path, and the images. That is unusual leverage, and we intend to use it. You will drive platform-level hardening across the OS we ship: A hardened, defensible default configuration for the distribution Advancing SELinux enforcement across RING and S3C (work already begun on the team, which you will help carry) Supply-chain integrity: artifact provenance, signing, dependency currency, reproducible and verifiable builds Secrets and credential handling across the delivery pipeline Cryptographic posture — including FIPS 140-3 readiness, which matters concretely: FIPS 140-2 certificates move to NIST’s historical list on 22 September 2026, and RHEL 9’s validated OpenSSL, GnuTLS, and kernel crypto modules are the foundation we build on Compliance-driven engineering work, notably the supply-chain security expectations of NIS2 (Article 21(2)(d)) and the EU Cyber Resilience Act — translated into automation and evidence, not spreadsheets You will also contribute to what comes next: threat modelling of the platform, hardening guidance for customers, and security review of significant design changes. What We Are Looking For This is a role for someone early in their career who wants to grow into being their team’s security reference. We expect to invest in you, and we expect you to keep growing here for as long as you want to — there is no ceiling built into this seat. Required Linux is your primary operating system — at work, at home, or both. You are comfortable in the terminal and you reach for a shell before a UI Roughly 2–4 years of relevant experience, or a shorter track record with unusually strong evidence of the skills below Solid working ability in Python and Bash — you will be writing and maintaining real code in a production codebase A genuine, demonstrable interest in security. We care much more about this than about formal credentials. Show it however it is true for you: CTFs, a home lab, reading advisories and CVE writeups for fun, a hardening project, security-adjacent contributions, a blog, anything real Comfortable using Git in a collaborative environment Ability to read and understand existing code before modifying it The judgement to tell a real risk from a scanner’s opinion — and the instinct to check whether vulnerable code is actually reachable before calling it exposed The willingness to say plainly when you are not yet sure, rather than producing an answer you could not defend French — the team works in French day to day Written communication skills in English Nice to Have CVE triage, CVSS scoring, or vulnerability management experience Reading vendor advisories and understanding vendor triage — NVD, RHSA, Red Hat severity and will-not-fix calls Supply-chain security tooling — SBOM formats (SPDX, CycloneDX), scanners (Trivy, Grype, Syft), artifact signing RPM packaging or Linux distribution internals SELinux policy work CI/CD systems, especially GitHub Actions RHEL / Rocky Linux (versions 8 and 9) Containers (Docker, containerd, systemd units) Ansible or Salt Awareness of NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act, or FIPS 140-3 Familiarity with S3 or object storage concepts Serious use of AI coding tools in a real workflow — Claude Code or equivalent, beyond autocomplete To Be Clear About Scope This is a software engineering role with a security mandate. It is not a SOC or incident-response analyst position, not a penetration-testing role, and not a GRC or compliance-documentation role. If what you want is to build the tooling and harden the system yourself, in code, you are in the right place. What We Offer Dedicated focus. Security is your job here, not the thing you get to after the sprint work is done Clear direction, and a say in it. Security priorities are owned by our VP of Engineering, and the team is accountable for delivering them. You would not be inventing the agenda on your own, you would help shape what goes on it, and you would be part of making it stick A network of peers. Security engineers embedded in the other development teams, working the same problems on different perimeters Work that compounds. Customer security questions are a permanent obligation, so every assessment you make reusable and every check you automate keeps paying back, release after release Modern tooling, actually adopted. Claude Code in every engineer’s hands, and a real say in how AI reshapes our build and delivery chain A rare combination: security work with the leverage of owning the whole stack, down to our own Linux

title: Senior Engineer, Data Infrastructure
description: <p><strong>Position Summary:</strong></p> <p>Quotient is seeking a Senior Engineer in our Data Infrastructure team to design and evolve our cloud, data and AI infrastructure underpinning our genomics-first drug discovery platform.</p> <p>Working within the Data Infrastructure team, you will lead complex initiatives spanning AWS platform engineering, scientific data systems and AI/ML workloads. You will collaborate closely with cloud engineers, data engineers, bioinformaticians, AI scientists, computational biologists, and experimental scientists to turn evolving scientific needs into secure, reliable and scalable engineering solutions.</p> <p>This is a senior individual-contributor role with substantial technical autonomy. You will make cross-system architecture and operational trade-offs, establish reusable engineering patterns, and mentor our Cloud Engineers and Data Engineers through design reviews, delivery and troubleshooting. The role does not require formal line management, but it does require clear technical leadership and accountability for platform outcomes.</p> <p>This hybrid role is based at the Chesterford Research Campus, near Cambridge, and reports to the Head of Data Infrastructure. The successful candidate will normally work from the campus at least three days per week, participate in operational support and incident escalation, and must have permission to work in the UK.</p> title: Office Manager / EA Support
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Global Workplace Teams Our Global Workplace team helps create exceptional spaces and experiences for colleagues, customers and visitors at Wayve. As our Office Manager / EA Support in Leonberg, you’ll take ownership of the office’s day-to-day operations, working with colleagues across the business to keep our workplace safe, welcoming and running smoothly. You’ll join a collaborative team with opportunities to shape how our workplaces evolve as Wayve grows. 🧠 Your day-to-day Keep our Leonberg office well-presented, fully stocked and operating efficiently. Be the go-to person for colleagues’ workplace questions and needs, responding with a proactive, service-focused approach. Coordinate suppliers, contractors, building management, deliveries and catering. Prepare meeting rooms and organise hospitality for executive meetings and customer visits. Support new starters by preparing desks, access and welcome materials. Provide administrative support to the People team, including posting, printing and filing documents. 🧩 What you’ll be working on Planning and delivering office events, socials and initiatives that bring colleagues together. Creating a welcoming, well-organised experience for customers and visitors. Maintaining a safe workplace through routine health and safety inspections and proactive follow-up. Identifying and implementing improvements to office processes, workplace services and the overall colleague experience. 🙌 You should apply if You have experience managing a busy office in a fast-paced environment. You’ve led or supervised a Reception or Front of House team and maintained high service standards. You’re highly organised, detail-oriented and able to balance competing priorities with calm judgement. You have experience coordinating suppliers, contractors and building management, as well as organising events and hospitality. You communicate clearly and build strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders. You take pride in creating an excellent workplace experience and spot opportunities to improve things without waiting to be asked. You’re comfortable working on-site in Leonberg five days per week. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen Competency Interviews Deep-dive interviews Final interview : mission & values alignment We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law. For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory. title: Cyber Exposure Management Expert (m/w/d)

You will test accuracy and usefulness, protect client data and define human oversight, including approval before AI recommendations trigger remediation actions; Turning client needs into service packages, technical standards and delivery methods, coaching consultants and providing technical input for proposals and scoping; Developing the service roadmap and evaluating new capabilities through pilots, including CTEM, Attack Surface analysis and cryptographic discovery, Crypto Agility and Post Quantum Cryptography migration planning. Experience developing a consulting service is an advantage; Interest in developing CTEM and Quantum Readiness services and testing AI applications in security operations. title: Senior Process Engieer
description: ABOUT US tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a cleaner and more innovative future. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes. This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering, and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our future plants are built on solid fundamentals. Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with: a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development. We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Must Have's: 1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up ● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants. ● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions. ● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design criteria and scale-up assumptions. ● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than theoretical assumptions alone. 2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization ● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps. ● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing. ● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and translate these insights into concrete process improvements. ● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on process performance and technology development rather than daily troubleshooting. 3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling ● Turn plant data into engineering decisions. ● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process performance. ● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions. ● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality. ● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and future plant designs. 4. Commissioning & Process Validation ● Make sure what we designed actually works. ● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance validation for new equipment and plant expansions. ● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original design intent. ● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed systems achieve their calculated performance targets. ● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership transfers once the process meets its design criteria. 5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs ● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently. ● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation. ● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews, ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather than after installation. ● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process parameters of newly commissioned systems. Nice-to-have's: Vendor & EPC Coordination ● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners and equipment suppliers. ● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering documentation. ● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process. ● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability. ● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and equipment vendors throughout project execution. 4. The role requires regular on-site presence in Gendorf, with an expectation of approximately 2 days per week on average . Depending on project needs and plant activities, some weeks may require more on-site presence, while others may require less. Your profile You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and real plant data. ● Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or a related technical field. ● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical, hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing is highly preferred. ● Strong experience with process design and scale-up, including PFDs, P&IDs, mass/energy balances and equipment sizing. ● Comfortable working with industrial datasets and translating operational data into engineering models and decisions. ● Experience with solid-liquid separation, precipitation, flotation, hydrometallurgy or mineral processing is highly valuable. ● Able to critically review vendor proposals and confidently challenge technical assumptions. ● Strong experience supporting commissioning and process validation of industrial equipment or plants. ● Familiarity with process safety methodologies such as HAZOP and LOPA. ● Comfortable moving between detailed calculations, engineering documentation and the actual plant. ● Strong communicator who can work effectively across R&D, Engineering, Operations, suppliers and EPC partners. ● Fluent English; German is a plus. Why us? Our technology is moving from first-of-a-kind industrial operations toward increasingly larger and more standardized plants. The Senior Process Engineer will help us make that transition successfully: turning what we learn from today's plant into the engineering basis for tomorrow's plants while supporting commissioning and ramping up efforts. You will directly influence process performance, equipment selection, CAPEX and the technical architecture of our future facilities — helping ensure that every new scale is safer, simpler, more efficient and better engineered than the one before it. title: Quality & Regulatory Affairs Manager (m/w/d) befristete Elternzeitvertretung
description: Über uns: Die ADDVANCE Consumer Health Group GmbH (vormals Vitafy) wurde 2014 in München gegründet und hat sich zu einer führenden B2C-Online-Plattform mit eigenen starken Endkundenmarken entwickelt. title: Account Executive – Full-Cycle, New Business (m/f/d)
description: THE JOB Reading this to the end is worth it. The Company: Why mute-labs? mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We are self-funded, profitable since day one, and have no investors to answer to and no exit to chase. What we do have is a steep growth curve in revenue, a product made in Germany, and a genuine mission: giving the modern office some quiet back. We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you. Outbound is not a new idea for us. title: Senior Technical Programme Manager, Quantum Systems Infrastructure
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&index=7&md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&index=8&md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51" target="_blank">Amazon Web Services, </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=and&index=9&md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c" target="_blank">and </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=AstraZeneca&index=10&md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f" target="_blank">AstraZeneca</a></u> achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&index=11&md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><p><strong>Location:</strong> Oxford, England<br><strong>Travel:</strong> As needed<strong><br>Job ID:</strong> 1905</p> <p><strong>The Role:<br></strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Technical Programme Manager to join the Quantum Systems Infrastructure (QSI) team at IonQ's Oxford office. QSI builds and runs the platform our next-generation quantum computers are built, tested, released and operated on, from bare metal in the lab to cloud, working across both Oxford and the US.</p> <p>Your mission is to run the machinery that keeps QSI’s portfolio visible, planned and unblocked so engineers can engineer, leaders can lead, and the business always knows what is changing and why it matters. You will work very closely with the Technical Programme Managers in the Software and Science teams, ensuring our processes and workflows complement and integrate with their work, rather than duplicating effort. </p> <p>We run a centralised PMO operating model at IonQ which you will be a core part of though on a day to day basis you will work alongside the QSI team. As part of this model, this role will not make technical decisions, own engineering headcount, or define product but it will make the programme around those things run.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:</p> <p>You will own programme execution across QSI’s delivery streams, translating a leadership-visible roadmap into clear plans, measurable milestones and predictable delivery. You will create and run the operating rhythm that keeps teams aligned and leaders informed. When priorities shift, you will implement structure to that ambiguity, clarifying scope, coordinating trade-offs and pushing problems to resolution.</p> <p>Key responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li>Owning programme execution across QSI’s delivery streams: one planning rhythm, one backlog discipline, ensuring dependencies and risks surfaced early and chased to resolution.</li> <li>Running the roadmap-to-delivery link: keeping the roadmap, Jira and reality agreeing with each other, and making slippage visible early.</li> <li>Owning the programme ceremonies and the design of the workflows behind them (day-to-day stand-ups are run by the engineering managers).</li> <li>Working hand-in-hand with the Software and Science TPMs: shared or integrated processes wherever teams interact, and no duplicated ceremonies, boards or reporting.</li> <li>Coordinating across teams - Continuing Engineering (US), the PMO, product and science teams - serving as QSI’s cross-functional programme liaison.</li> <li>Establishing programme cadences and reporting (changelogs, demos, leadership summaries etc) in plain English that non-infrastructure stakeholders can read and trust.</li> <li>Running the intake and triage process so requests reach the right stream with the right priority, without engineers being interrupt-driven.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a technically fluent Programme Manager who brings structure, pace and clarity to a fast-moving infrastructure organisation. You will be comfortable working in a deeply technical environment, working daily with platform and systems engineers, while translating progress, risks and trade-offs into clear reporting senior stakeholders can trust. You will thrive in ambiguity and an organisation where you are able to drive change. You do not just coordinate: you unblock teams, keep plans honest, and raise the bar on how programmes are run.</p> <p>You will have prior experience tunning technical programmes across multiple engineering teams, ideally in infrastructure, platform or systems engineering environments. You should be fluent with modern programme tooling, such as Jira, Confluence and GitHub, and have the judgement to keep process lightweight.</p> <p>You’d be a great fit with:</p> <ul> <li>Experience harmonising ways of working across sibling teams or departments, integrating processes rather than multiplying them.</li> <li>Strong, plain-English communication and the ability to make infrastructure work legible to non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously across sites and time zones in a fast-paced, changing environment.</li> <li>A chase-without-nagging, escalate-without-drama working style, and a clear sense of the difference between a risk and a noise.</li> </ul> <p>Additional experience would be beneficial, such as a background in hardware-adjacent software (labs, manufacturing, robotics, scientific instruments), exposure to regulated or government-customer delivery, or agile coaching / scrum mastery experience. Working knowledge of quantum computing concepts would be a plus though is not essential.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <p>Be part of a team that’s shaping the future of quantum. We offer more than just a role, you’ll join a world class community of scientists, engineers and innovators working to unlock the full potential of quantum computing.</p> <p>We offer a range of benefits, including opportunities to further your career alongside industry leaders, a competitive salary with IonQ stock options, an annual performance bonus, generous annual leave, flexible hybrid working, private medical and dental insurance for you and your family, and much more.</p> <p>Join us and be part of the future of quantum computing.</p> <p>We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. </p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br> <br>We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs. </strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.  Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.  Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.  Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.  </p> <p><stron

title: Working Student
description: Who We Are AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change, and the toolchain is the new constraint. We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations: Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we are bolting on, it is central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we are heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build. We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community. Our Values Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding, and we strive to understand different viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. Who You Are You are studying for a master's degree and want to see how a remote-first technology company really runs day to day. You like variety: one day might be a customer's supplier questionnaire, the next a recurring task you're automating with Claude. You enjoy working out how a process works and then making it better. You work independently and in a structured way, and you're comfortable asking questions and working with Security, Legal and Finance to get something done. You care about the details, because supplier registrations and internal records need to be right. You're curious about AI and automation tools, and you want to use them on real work instead of just reading about them. If you meet most of the qualifications below and the role interests you, apply. Curiosity and a willingness to learn matter more to us than a perfect match. Responsibilities We are looking for a working student to support our Operations and Financial Management department. The focus of this role is supporting the supplier registrations requested by our customers and helping us build and improve AI-supported workflows across the department. Your responsibilities include, among others: Supporting the registration of Develocity as a supplier in our customers' procurement portals, including completing recurring questionnaires and gathering supporting evidence, in coordination with the Security, Legal, and Finance teams. Learning our supplier registration process in depth, helping to implement improvements, and keeping the guides and training material up to date. Building, testing, and improving AI-supported workflows with Claude, as well as with common automation tools, to reduce recurring manual work. Helping to introduce new software tools, including writing short guides and answering questions from the teams. Assisting our Business Administration team with recurring administrative tasks and keeping our internal records and systems up to date. Supporting our Finance teams from time to time. Taking on other tasks across the department as they come up, which lets you get to know several areas over time. Minimum qualifications Enrolment in a master's program, for example in business administration, business informatics, financial controlling, or a comparable field. Basic understanding of business administration, attention to detail, and analytical thinking. Flexibility and an open mind, as the role combines very different tasks from several teams. An interest in improving current systems and processes, and you enjoy working with automation and AI tools such as Claude Code. An independent, focused, and structured way of working, along with a collaborative mindset and good communication skills. German at C2 or native level, English at B2 level or higher. What We Offer An immediate start, with weekly hours agreed individually around your studies. A dynamic working environment in a Silicon Valley company with flat hierarchies and plenty of room for initiative and development. Work at an international, fast-moving technology leader. Onboarding and guidance from experienced colleagues. In-person meetings, such as regular department and company meetings. Work from home in a remote-first environment. A diverse and inclusive environment in which we learn from one another. We welcome people with different backgrounds, experiences, skills and perspectives. Location Remote from anywhere in Germany. Our headquarters is in San Francisco, and our teams work remotely across locations, which allows for a high degree of flexibility, collaboration and creativity. The Operations and Financial Management department is led from the Saarbrücken area in Germany and is responsible for the entire group. While we work remotely, with everything in place for seamless collaboration by email, chat and video call, we deeply value in-person time and meet regularly as a department and as a company. title: Account Manager Lille
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Pourquoi Deliveroo ? Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent. Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d'un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre! Tes principales missions : Gérer un portefeuille de restaurants clés sur des zones matures, où l'expertise et l'attention au détail font toute la différence. Développer des partenariats privilégiés et durables en devenant le point de contact expert de votre zone et en mettant à profit vos connaissances Food Tech. Optimiser la performance de vos comptes grâce à un accompagnement personnalisé, construit sur le long terme et nourri par la data. Analyser les résultats de vos restaurants, identifier les leviers d'amélioration et recommander des actions concrètes à votre manager tout en restant agile et ouvert à la nouveauté. Proposer et mettre en place des campagnes marketing et promotionnelles ciblées pour booster l'attractivité de vos restaurants partenaires. Suivre de près le déroulé des opérations afin de garantir la meilleure expérience restaurant et client possible. Ton expérience et tes qualités : Tu as déjà 2 à 3 ans d'expérience sur un rôle similaire où la gestion d'un portefeuille de partenaires était centrale à ta mission. Tu sais négocier et anticiper les discussions commerciales tout en gardant à l'esprit les valeurs de Deliveroo. Tu sais garder le contrôle de ton portefeuille , identifier les nouvelles tendances du marché et partager du feedback utile à tes partenaires ainsi qu'à ton manager. Le terrain est un lieu où tu te sens à ta place : tu sais construire des relations de confiance avec tes partenaires tout en gardant un œil attentif sur la concurrence. Tu sais te montrer proactif , analyser les résultats de tes actions et proposer des recommandations concrètes à ton manager. Tu travailles de manière autonome tout en gardant le cap fixé, sais t'approprier des objectifs précis et mets tout en œuvre pour les atteindre. Tu sais concevoir des actions spécifiques , adaptées à la fois aux besoins de tes partenaires et à la stratégie définie par ton manager. Tu sais identifier, comprendre et analyser les données de performance (commerciales et opérationnelles) pour garantir un niveau de service irréprochable. Tu sais t'exprimer en anglais (à l'oral comme à l'écrit) Tu arrives à convaincre tout en construisant des relations commerciales solides, durables, où Deliveroo devient le partenaire de choix Et si tu cherches un poste où tu travailles en full remote depuis Lille , tout en gardant un lien fort avec le terrain et les équipes, alors c'est peut‑être le rôle qu'il te faut ! La vie chez Deliveroo Notre équipe est en forte croissance, notre impact très important, et nous cherchons à répondre aux questions les plus stimulantes du moment. Nous progressons rapidement, nous explorons toujours de nouvelles idées et nous sommes très transparents quant aux décisions que nous prenons et à ce qui motive nos choix. Il y a tellement de questions que nous souhaitons résoudre, et encore plus que nous n'avons pas encore rencontrées. Comment les données et la technologie peuvent-elles aider les restaurants à développer leur activité à mesure que les habitudes des consommateurs évoluent ? Comment pouvons-nous prédire ce qu'une personne souhaitera pour dîner avant même que l'idée ne lui vienne à l'esprit ? Chez Deliveroo, ces questions ne sont que quelques-uns des défis ambitieux auxquels nous nous efforçons de répondre – et il n'y a aucun projet qui ne peut pas devenir le vôtre. Aucune solution n'appartient à une équipe en particulier, ce qui vous ouvre d'extraordinaires possibilités en termes de développement et d'impact personnel. Avantages et diversité À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l'article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité professionnelle, l'emploi des personnes en situation de handicap. Deliveroo France valorise la diversité sans discrimination de genre, race, sexualité, religion ou préférences personnelles. Avec un score de 99/100 à l'Indice de l'Égalité Hommes-Femmes 2023, nous sommes engagés envers l'égalité des chances. Rejoignez-nous avec votre passion pour la nourriture dans une entreprise en pleine croissance. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. title: Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d)

Du triffst Entscheidungen eigenständig und übernimmst echte Budgetverantwortung. Erfahrung: Du hast bereits Paid-Search- oder Paid-Social-Kampagnen mit vier- bis fünfstelligen Monatsbudgets aufgebaut und gesteuert. Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest analytisch, proaktiv und lösungsorientiert. Nicht mehr kochen: Jeden Abend ab 19 Uhr bestellen wir Essen fürs Team. 3+2 Hybrid Work: Drei Tage arbeitest du mit dem Team im Office, bis zu zwei Tage remote. Top Lage & Ausstattung: Unser modernes Office liegt in Berlin-Mitte, zwischen Hackeschem Markt und Alexanderplatz. Du arbeitest mit erstklassiger technischer Ausstattung, inklusive MacBook. Strategy-Offsites: Regelmäßig nehmen wir uns als ganzes Team raus und arbeiten gemeinsam an der Strategie und Zukunft von Arvana. Kostenlos trainieren: Mit der Urban Sports Club M-Mitgliedschaft trainierst du ohne Zusatzkosten. Bereit mit uns die deutsche B2B-Software Branche zu entwickeln? Sneak Peek: So läuft dein Bewerbungsprozess bei Arvana ab 1. Kurzes Kennenlernen Nach deiner Bewerbung melden wir uns schnell bei dir. title: Customer Care Manager (m/f/d)

title: Working Student - Social Media & Content
description: As our Working Student in Social Media & Content, you help shape how Maple Aviation shows up to the world. We are building autonomous aircraft for time-critical medical logistics and there are plenty of stories worth telling along the way. From flight tests and engineering milestones to product demonstrations, partnerships and everyday life inside a growing aerospace startup. You will help turn these moments into content that people want to stop, watch and engage with. Tasks Create content for our social media channels, from ideas and copy to photography, short-form video and simple graphics. Help plan and manage our social media calendar and publish content across relevant platforms. Capture what is happening at Maple including flight tests, product developments, events, team moments and behind-the-scenes stories. Turn technical topics into clear, engaging stories that people outside the engineering world can understand. Support photo and video productions, including shooting, editing and preparing content for different formats. Monitor channel performance and use insights to understand what works and what we should do differently. Keep our communication visually and verbally consistent across social media. Stay close to new formats, platform trends and creative ideas and bring the good ones into Maple. Requirements We care less about having the perfect CV than about your curiosity, creative instinct and ability to make things happen. You are currently studying Marketing, Communication, Media, Design, Languages or a related field. You have a strong interest in social media, content creation, storytelling and visual communication. You know how to recognize a good story and turn it into content people actually want to watch or read. You are comfortable taking photos and shooting video and have a good eye for composition, light and visual storytelling. You can write clearly and confidently in English. German or Italian is a plus. You are familiar with basic editing and content creation tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva, CapCut or similar. You are proactive and self-driven. You do not wait for someone to tell you every next step. You are curious about aviation, technology and innovation and willing to learn enough about what we build to communicate it well. Bonus: You already create content yourself, have managed a social media channel, or can show us photography, video or other creative work you are proud of. Benefits Real ownership of content that will be seen by customers, partners, applicants and the wider aviation community. A front-row seat to building an autonomous aviation company from the inside. Direct exposure to engineers, product development, flight testing and real-world drone operations. The freedom to experiment with formats and bring your own ideas to the table. Flexible working hours around your studies. Wellpass: Fitness, Wellness & Sports. Team events. An international, hands-on team based in Ottobrunn, Munich. If you like technology, visual storytelling and the idea of turning what happens behind the scenes of an aerospace startup into stories people care about, we would love to hear from you. title: Sr. Software Engineer
description: <h1>Sr. Software Engineer</h1> <h2>The Team + The Role</h2> <p>Pendo's engineering teams build the product experiences that help customers understand, improve, and act on product usage data. This team is focused on AI-powered features that turn raw usage signals into automatic, actionable suggestions, reducing the manual work customers need to do before they can get value from Pendo.</p> <p>As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help shape and ship intelligent product experiences from discovery through delivery. You will work full-stack with a lean toward frontend, using TypeScript, Vue.js, backend services, and AI coding tools to build high-quality features on a small, fast-moving team. This role also owns product judgment: validating problems with customers, sizing opportunities, defining success metrics, and making pragmatic tradeoffs in ambiguous spaces.</p> <p>This role is based in our Sheffield office.</p> <h2>What this looks like day-to-day</h2> <ul> <li><strong>AI-powered feature delivery:</strong> Build and ship features that use AI to turn product usage data into actionable suggestions for customers. You will work end to end across the experience, with attention to quality, usability, and the unique failure modes of AI-backed products.</li> <li><strong>Full-stack engineering:</strong> Own delivery across the frontend and backend, with a strong lean toward TypeScript, Vue.js, DOM-level work, component architecture, and in-browser data capture. You will reason about backend services and APIs while building polished, reliable customer-facing experiences.</li> <li><strong>Product discovery:</strong> Help validate problems, shape scope, and test direction before and while building. You will join customer calls, test prototypes, and use real feedback to make sure the team is solving meaningful problems.</li> <li><strong>Success metrics and iteration:</strong> Define what success looks like for the features you build and use product usage data to guide iteration. You will not just close tickets; you will measure whether the work is creating the intended customer impact.</li> <li><strong>AI-enabled development:</strong> Use AI coding tools such as Cursor and Claude Code as a core part of your daily workflow. You will apply strong engineering judgment, review rigor, and accountability to AI-generated code just as you would to your own.</li> <li><strong>AI product quality:</strong> Ship AI-backed features with careful attention to latency, hallucination, inconsistent output, and user trust. You will help ensure intelligent experiences are useful, understandable, and reliable for customers.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional collaboration:</strong> Work directly with product, design, and fellow engineers in a small team where ownership and leverage matter. You will help make pragmatic tradeoffs against ambiguous, fast-moving requirements instead of waiting for a fully defined spec.</li> <li><strong>Engineering standards:</strong> Raise the quality of the team through code review, mentorship, and unblocking teammates. You will communicate clearly, share context, and help others grow while keeping delivery moving.</li> </ul> <h2>Who You Are</h2> <p>Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.</p> <p>You're a builder, not a maintainer.</p> <p>You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Senior Software Engineers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.</p> <p>You're AI-curious - genuinely.</p> <p>You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.</p> <h2>Must-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience building with LLMs and AI agents, whether through production work or personal projects. You have built something with these technologies, not just used them as tools.</li> <li>Full-stack engineering experience with a frontend lean, including strong TypeScript skills, comfort working with the DOM, and the ability to reason about backend services.</li> <li>3+ years of experience building and scaling web applications.</li> <li>Strong product judgment, including comfort owning ambiguous problems, shaping scope, and making decisions without a fully specified brief.</li> <li>Experience defining success metrics for a feature and iterating based on real usage data.</li> <li>Experience engaging directly with customers or end users to validate problems and assess impact after launch.</li> <li>Strong grasp of software architecture, design principles, and API development.</li> <li>Clear communication skills and the ability to mentor others, unblock teammates, and support the growth of the engineering team.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Experience working as, or closely alongside, a product manager, including writing specs, prioritizing a roadmap, or running discovery.</li> <li>Familiarity with product analytics tools such as Pendo, Amplitude, or Mixpanel to measure feature impact.</li> <li>Experience designing or running experiments, including A/B tests or betas, to validate product decisions.</li> <li>Experience with browser DOM inspection or automation.</li> <li>Familiarity with Model Context Protocol or building tools for LLM agents.</li> <li>Familiarity with real-time data pipelines or streaming architectures.</li> <li>Accessibility experience.</li> <li>Passion for continuous learning and sharing insights with the team.</li> </ul> <h2>About Pendo</h2> <p>Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.</p> <p><strong>Pendo Core Values:</strong> Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Pendo is a hybrid culture. In-office 3 days per week unless designated remote.</p> <p><strong>Compensation:</strong> The expected salary range for this role to be performed in Sheffield, United Kingdom is £60,000 - £78,000.</p> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong> Comprehensive, top-tier coverage in the United Kingdom, including medical, dental, and life coverage, combined with pension match, equity, and high-value lifestyle perks.</p> <p><strong>EEOC:</strong> We are an equal opportunity employer and believe having diverse teams where everyone brings their whole self to Pendo is key to our success. We welcome all people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.</p> <p><strong>Accessibility:</strong> Pendo is committed to working with, and providing access and reasonable accommodation to, applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you think you may require an accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, please send a request to: ----- All requests for accommodations are treated discreetly and confidentially, as practical and permitted by law.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: SEO Manager, EU/UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. </li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. </li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p>Europe is Quince's next growth engine. We have launched in the UK, with further European markets on the roadmap, and organic discovery is one of the biggest untapped levers we have.</p> <p>We are looking for an SEO Manager, UK & EU. You will own the organic strategy for our European markets across both traditional search and generative engines (AEO), building our European playbook.</p> <p>This is a cross-market, hands-on role with an unusual amount of ownership. Technical SEO standards and platform-level architecture come primarily from our global SEO team in the US; you are the person who translates those foundations into a European strategy, identifies where Europe needs something different, and makes the case for it. You will work day to day with storefront, copywriting, merchandising, growth marketing, engineering and data — and you will be the main driver for organic growth in the region.</p> <p>If you want to build an organic program from the ground up in markets where the brand is still being established, this is that job.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What you'll do</strong></span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own the UK/EU SEO & AEO strategy.</strong> Build and maintain a market-level roadmap that reflects the real competitive dynamics of each country rather than a copy of the US plan. Decide where we play, which categories we go after first, and what winning looks like in each market.</li> <li><strong>Partner closely with the global SEO team.</strong> Adopt and apply global technical standards, feed European requirements into the global roadmap, and flag where a one-size-fits-all approach breaks down in-market.</li> <li><strong>Drive answer engine optimisation across Europe.</strong> Build Quince's presence in AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and the surfaces that follow. Own structured data coverage, entity and brand consistency, citation-worthy content, and the measurement approach that tells us whether any of it is working.</li> <li><strong>Make localisation a search advantage, not an afterthought.</strong> Work with copywriting and localisation to ensure category, PDP and editorial content targets genuine local search demand — not translated US keywords. Build the keyword and demand research foundation for each market and turn it into briefs writers can act on.</li> <li><strong>Own international search architecture in-market.</strong> Hreflang and market targeting, URL and domain structure, canonical logic, indexation of localised catalogues, and the crawl health of each European storefront — specced and QA'd with global SEO and engineering, with you accountable for the outcome.</li> <li><strong>Shape the storefront with merchandising and site merch.</strong> Influence category taxonomy, navigation, on-site search and PLP structure so that pages serve organic discovery as well as conversion. Partner on how content is modelled in our CMS and how listing pages are built and ranked.</li> <li><strong>Work in lockstep with growth marketing.</strong> Understand where organic and paid overlap, where they cannibalise, and where organic can take load off paid spend. Bring an incrementality mindset to the way we report and invest.</li> <li><strong>Own SEO/AEO readiness for new market launches.</strong> Define the checklist, run it, and make sure every new European storefront goes live search-ready rather than being retrofitted six months later.</li> <li><strong>Measure, report and build the case for investment.</strong> Own market-level organic reporting and the quarterly narrative for European and global leadership.</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Required experience</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>5+ years in SEO, ideally in ecommerce, retail or consumer brands, with meaningful ownership of organic performance.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience running SEO across more than one country or language.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of technical SEO: crawl and indexation, site architecture, structured data, page performance. </li> <li>Content-led SEO experience: keyword and demand research, content strategy, briefing writers, and building category and editorial content that ranks and converts.</li> <li>Practical exposure to AEO — structured data, entity management, and a real point of view on how Quince should show up in AI-driven discovery.</li> <li>Comfortable in the data: Google Search Console, GA4, and the standard SEO toolset (Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog or similar).</li> <li>Excellent communicator in English, and effective working asynchronously with a headquarters team in another time zone.</li> <li>A bias for shipping. You are happy operating without a large team, deciding what matters most this quarter, and doing the work yourself.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Preferred</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Working proficiency in English and, preferably, a second language (e.g. German, French, or Spanish).</li> <li>Experience launching ecommerce storefronts in new countries.</li> <li>Familiarity with headless CMS and search stacks (e.g. Contentful, Algolia) and translation management platforms (e.g. Smartling).</li> <li>Experience using AI-assisted tooling to produce or optimise content, metadata and structured data at scale.</li> <li>Apparel, home or lifestyle retail experience in the European market.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who you are</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>You think in systems. You would rather build a repeatable process that scales to five markets than win one category by hand.</li> <li>You are genuinely curious about how discovery is changing, and you are already testing how AI-driven search behaves in your own markets.</li> <li>You are persuasive without authority. Much of your impact comes from convincing merchandisers, writers, engineers and a global team to prioritise your work.</li> <li>You are commercially minded. You connect organic performance to revenue, not just to rankings.</li> <li>You are comfortable with ambiguity and with being early. Europe is not a finished operation, and you will help decide what it becomes.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-renderer-start-pos="3319"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">WHY QUINCE?</u></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3352">Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing <a href="https://forms.gle/DpJ11jHa1WbqfUWB9">this accommodation form</a>. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direkter Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung. Bei uns kannst du Verantwortung übernehmen, eigene Ideen einbringen und unmittelbar sehen, was deine Arbeit bewirkt. Wir suchen jemanden, der unseren IT-Service nicht nur organisiert, sondern eigenständig mitgestaltet und gemeinsam mit dem Team voranbringt. Aufgaben Du übernimmst die operative Steuerung unseres IT-Services und sorgst dafür, dass aus offenen Aufgaben zuverlässig abgeschlossene Ergebnisse werden. Deine Aufgaben: Du koordinierst unsere Techniker, planst Einsätze und setzt eigenständig Prioritäten. Du verteilst Aufgaben verbindlich, gibst Orientierung und unterstützt das Team dabei, gute Ergebnisse zu erzielen – respektvoll und auf Augenhöhe. Du bist Ansprechpartner für unsere Geschäftskunden, klärst Anliegen und vereinbarst realistische Termine. Du behältst laufende Aufträge im Blick, erkennst Hindernisse und sorgst für deren Beseitigung. Du erkennst, wenn etwas nicht funktioniert, entwickelst eine Lösung, setzt sie gemeinsam mit dem Team um und prüfst, ob sie tatsächlich wirkt. Du nutzt freie Kapazitäten wirtschaftlich sinnvoll, erkennst zusätzliche Kundenbedarfe und bringst Aufträge voran. Du stellst sicher, dass erbrachte Leistungen vollständig dokumentiert und für die Abrechnung vorbereitet werden. Du verbesserst gemeinsam mit dem Team unsere Arbeitsabläufe. Du triffst operative Entscheidungen innerhalb klarer Zuständigkeiten selbstständig. Du musst nicht für jede Entscheidung die Geschäftsführung fragen. Qualifikation Du arbeitest strukturiert, behältst den Überblick und kommst ins Handeln. Auch wenn mehrere Dinge gleichzeitig passieren, kannst du Prioritäten setzen und nachvollziehbare Entscheidungen treffen. Das bringst du mit: Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch, freundlich und verbindlich – auch am Telefon mit Geschäftskunden. Du hast ein grundlegendes Verständnis für IT und technische Zusammenhänge. Du kannst Aufgaben koordinieren, klare Erwartungen formulieren und Ergebnisse nachverfolgen. Du arbeitest eigenständig, erkennst Probleme und entwickelst praktikable Lösungen. Du gehst respektvoll mit Menschen um und kannst dich gleichzeitig klar durchsetzen. Du übernimmst Verantwortung und bleibst dran, bis vereinbarte Ergebnisse erreicht sind. Erfahrungen in IT-Service, Helpdesk, technischer Disposition, Kundenservice oder Teamkoordination sind hilfreich. Du musst nicht bereits eine formale Führungsposition ausgeübt haben. Entscheidend ist, dass du Verantwortung übernehmen kannst und Freude daran hast, gemeinsam mit anderen Ergebnisse zu erreichen. Benefits Bei uns bekommst du die Möglichkeit, wirklich etwas zu bewegen: Einen eigenständigen Verantwortungsbereich mit klaren Entscheidungsbefugnissen Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen umzusetzen Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung Ein kleines Team mit persönlichem Austausch und gegenseitiger Unterstützung Moderne Werkzeuge für Tickets, Einsatzplanung und Kundenbetreuung Eine Einarbeitung in unsere Systeme und Arbeitsabläufe Eine unbefristete Anstellung mit 35–40 Wochenstunden Einen Arbeitsplatz in Bremerhaven Wir suchen keine Person, die lediglich Aufgaben verwaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der gemeinsam mit uns einen zuverlässigen und wirtschaftlich erfolgreichen IT-Service gestaltet. Du möchtest nicht nur organisieren, sondern Verantwortung übernehmen und Ergebnisse gestalten? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Uns interessiert nicht nur dein Lebenslauf, sondern vor allem, wie du Herausforderungen angehst und Verantwortung übernimmst. Eine kleine Aufgabe für deine Bewerbung: Beschreibe eine konkrete Situation aus deinem Berufsalltag, in der etwas schiefgelaufen ist und du selbst die Verantwortung übernommen hast. Was hast du persönlich getan und was war am Ende das Ergebnis? Drei bis fünf Sätze reichen. Schreibe deine Antwort einfach in deine Bewerbungsnachricht oder dein Anschreiben. Ein ausführliches Anschreiben ist nicht erforderlich. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Cards
