Here is what the Go-To-Market organization looks like at UpSlide: Account Executives: Prospect, acquire new business acquisition and expand existing accounts Consultants: Lead implementation projects, deliver client training, and ensure successful deployment Customer Success Managers: Own a portfolio of accounts end-to-end, driving retention, renewal signing, expansion within existing entities, value realization, and long-term account growth Support Engineers : Resolve day-to-day technical questions and issues, and ensure a smooth customer experience 🖋️ Your responsibilities As Support Team Lead, you will be the direct manager of our Support Engineers and accountable for the team's day-to-day performance, development, and service delivery. You will translate our Support strategy into effective routines, consistent execution, and an excellent customer experience. This is a player-coach role . Your primary focus is managing and developing the team, but you'll stay close to operations , supporting complex investigations, reviewing ticket quality, and coordinating escalations when needed. The Head of Support defines the strategy and long-term evolution of the function. You make sure the team delivers on it every day. We're looking for someone who is a natural people developer : accountable, structured, thorough, calm under pressure, data-informed, proactive, and collaborative. We strongly believe in growing our people internally, and this role is also a strong stepping stone toward broader Support and Customer Success leadership for those who want to keep growing. People Management & Team Development Directly manage, coach, and develop the Support Engineers to help them perform at their best and grow in their careers: Hold regular one-to-ones, set clear expectations, and provide frequent, actionable feedback Monitor individual performance, address issues when needed, and lead performance reviews and development plans Identify skills gaps and organize coaching, training, and knowledge-sharing Own onboarding and ramp-up for new team members, and participate in hiring Foster a culture of customer empathy, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement Daily Service Delivery & Escalation Management Own the daily delivery of Support and act as the first point of management escalation for complex, urgent, or sensitive cases: Monitor ticket queues, backlog, workload, and service levels, and ensure tickets are correctly prioritized and followed through Organize team coverage (absences, shifts, peak periods) and step in when service delivery is at risk Review and coordinate escalated tickets, defining next steps and involving the right internal stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success) Coordinate customer communication on significant cases, and escalate major risks or executive concerns to the Head of Support Quality, Process, & Performance Maintain high standards of technical quality, and bring a critical, structured eye to how Support operates today, proposing and driving changes rather than simply preserving the status quo: Identify where tickets could be resolved faster and more efficiently in writing, and reduce the number of cases that unnecessarily escalate into calls, especially multi-stakeholder ones, to protect everyone's time and improve the ROI of customer interactions Review ticket quality using QA tools and scorecards, and coach the team based on the results Ensure investigations are structured, well-documented, and clearly communicated to customers Monitor operational and quality indicators (backlog, response/resolution time, CSAT, quality scores) to identify risks and drive corrective action Document, monitor adoption of, and continuously improve Support workflows, in partnership with Support Operations Cross-functional Collaboration Make sure Support works effectively with the rest of the business. Coordinate with Product and Engineering on customer investigations and product issues Collaborate with Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales on customer situations requiring Support involvement, and continuously refine which team owns which type of request across the client lifecycle Clarify responsibilities and handovers between Support and other teams, and represent the team's operational needs in cross-functional discussions To work on these tasks, you will mainly use the following tools: Zendesk (or an equivalent ticketing platform), our data stack tools, Microsoft Office, UpSlide, and internal knowledge-base tools (or local equivalents). ⚡Your goals You will be assessed on: Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) Time to Resolution (TTR) Ticket-to-active-user ratio Team engagement and development You are a great fit if you have: Proven experience managing or leading a customer-facing team, ideally in B2B SaaS, technical support, or a similar operational environment Strong coaching and people-development skills, including the ability to give clear, constructive, and sometimes difficult feedback Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities across a team Experience using service or operational metrics to identify issues and improve performance Strong customer communication and escalation-management skills Ability to understand technical issues and guide structured investigations, without needing to personally own every ticket Fluent in French & English mandatory Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, and other customer-facing teams A pragmatic, accountable approach to problem-solving, with a bias for ownership over escalation We’d love it if you have: Experience directly managing a team of five or more people Experience supporting Enterprise customers Experience with Microsoft 365, Office add-ins, deployment, or IT environments Familiarity with Zendesk or a similar ticketing platform Experience with quality and knowledge management, or Support Operations Experience supporting distributed or international teams Familiarity with automation, AI-assisted Support, or self-service strategies ✨ If you don’t tick all the boxes but you think you’d be a great fit, please apply and tell us why. Recruitment process Screening call with a Talent Acquisition Specialist: A conversation to walk through your experience, motivation, and fit for the role. Interview with your future manager or their peer: A deeper dive into your management experience in Support. Case study and a team-meet: A live exercise reflecting real challenges of the role, followed by a conversation with members of the wider team. Final conversation with leadership: A closing discussion to align on ambition, expectations, and next steps. 🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive. On average, our process lasts 3 weeks. What we offer 🌍 International environment: Start-up with five offices (Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore) and users in more than 60 countries 🌱 Training & professional development: Collaboration with our sister company, IPH , which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management 🎉 Company events: Office socials and international company events (e.g. annual company seminar, team seminar, and sustainability actions taken throughout the year) 🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc. 💻 Hybrid work: 2-3 days in-office per week 🧑‍💻 Work-from-home budget: €500 WFH equipment budget 💆‍♀️ Wellness package: 50€ per month for physical and mental wellness activities 👶 Family support: Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents 4 days fully paid leave for sick children up to 6 years old or up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement Flexible return to work options An additional 5 days are fully paid within 6 months after becoming a parent ✈️ Holidays: 25 vacation days and 9 RTT (with one taken for Solidarity Day) ✅ General: Meal vouchers (Tickets resto): €11 per day on your Swile card (210 tickets per year) Healthcare insurance (Mutuelle): Covered by Alan. You can extend cover to your partner and children Commute (Transports): Metro, RER, bike, or e-scooter - These options are reimbursed 50% by UpSlide As a B Corp-certified company, we have strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels welcome. This commitment to diversity and inclusion is applied in our recruitment process and your employee experience once you’ve joined UpSlide ✨ Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Key Account Executive
description: Qui sommes-nous ? N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense . Tu seras amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale. Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…). Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous renforçons l'équipe Sales de Vertical Expense . Tu y prendras en charge le développement de grands comptes publics et privés, sur des ventes complexes à forts enjeux. Tu auras pour mission de : Piloter le cycle de vente de bout en bout : qualification des opportunités, proposition de valeur différenciante, accès aux décideurs, négociation et closing. Développer de nouvelles opportunités par une prospection ciblée, en complément des leads apportés par le Marketing et par nos équipes Alliances & Channel. Analyser les besoins de tes prospects et présenter la solution, avec l'appui de l'avant-vente sur les projets complexes. Rédiger les réponses aux appels d'offres publics et privés (dont le mémoire technique), en t'appuyant sur les équipes internes. Assurer une passation fluide vers les équipes projets et CSM, et suivre les projets en appui après la signature. Participer aux réflexions stratégiques : veille concurrentielle, tendances du marché, différenciateurs produit. Ce qu'on va attendre de toi : Tu as une expérience significative et récente en vente complexe SaaS B2B auprès de grands comptes. Tu as déjà mené des cycles de vente longs, dans des organisations multi-décideurs, en travaillant avec des partenaires et des influenceurs. Tu as un vrai goût pour la chasse : aller chercher de nouveaux clients te motive. Tu es à l'aise face à des interlocuteurs C-level et tu sais adapter ton discours à chacun (idéalement DAF, DRH, Travel Manager, DSI…). Tu sais répondre à un appel d'offres avec rigueur, de la réponse au mémoire technique. Tu comprends les solutions SaaS, web et mobiles. Tu es autonome, organisé(e) et tenace, et tu sais rebondir face à un deal perdu. Tu aimes travailler en équipe avec le Marketing, l’équipe Alliance/Channel, les équipes projets et le Produit. Tu es à l'aise avec des déplacements réguliers chez les clients (environ une fois par semaine). C'est un plus si : Tu connais l'univers des notes de frais ou du voyage d'affaires. Tu parles anglais. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un poste stratégique, au cœur de notre développement sur les grands comptes publics et privés. Pas que de la prospection à froid : une partie des leads vient du Marketing et de nos partenaires. Une vision complète du cycle de vente, jusqu'au suivi du projet client. Une équipe stable, fière de ses grands comptes, avec le sens du service et de l'excellence. Une ambiance où l'on ne se prend pas au sérieux : team building réguliers… Processus de recrutement : Entretien téléphonique RH. Entretien avec le manager. Mise en situation : étude de cas sur un compte client fictif. Entretien final avec la Direction. Localisation : Montagnat (01) et Aix-en-Provence, avec 1 jour par semaine sur chaque site et 3 jours de télétravail. Rémunération : fixe : 60K € - 80K€ + variable Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Planning and Supply Chain Manager
description: Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 At Quandela, we're moving from an R&D-driven organization toward a structured, scalable industrial operation. We're looking for a builder as much as a manager to create our end-to-end supply chain, from demand to customer delivery. Your first major challenge: build our S&OP process from the ground up. You'll move easily between strategy and execution, from running an S&OP review and an 18-month capacity outlook to solving a critical component shortage or securing an urgent customer shipment. Your Key Responsibilities Build the S&OP process from scratch: define governance, meeting cadence, roles, inputs and KPIs, then progressively mature it as the company scales Lead monthly cross-functional S&OP reviews with Sales, Operations, Production, R&D, Purchasing, Finance and Management, and establish a single shared view of demand, supply and customer commitments Consolidate demand from customer orders, weighted commercial forecasts, internal R&D needs, qualification activities and strategic programs into a rolling forecast Build and maintain the Master Production Schedule, with planning horizons adapted to our long manufacturing and supply lead times Translate demand into capacity, resource, material and supplier requirements, identify gaps and develop scenarios to support management decisions on priorities and commitments Turn the production plan into executable schedules, monitor WIP and progress, and coordinate recovery plans when delays or shortages occur Structure purchasing and MRP processes, define sourcing strategies based on lead time, criticality, supply risk, cost and MOQ, and track supplier performance (OTD, quality, responsiveness) Define inventory principles and safety-stock strategies for critical components, while managing excess, obsolete and slow-moving stock Organize inbound, internal and outbound logistics, including the transport of fragile, sensitive and high-value technological products Manage customs and international trade: import/export documentation, classification, country of origin, Incoterms and compliance, in coordination with forwarders and brokers Contribute to the selection and deployment of ERP/MRP and planning tools, reduce reliance on manual spreadsheets and build clear supply chain dashboards Define and track key KPIs (forecast accuracy, plan adherence, supplier and customer OTD/OTIF, inventory turns, shortages, lead times) and drive continuous improvement Requirements Master's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Engineering or a related field 5+ years of experience in planning, supply chain or industrial operations Proven experience implementing or running an S&OP process APICS / ASCM certification (CPIM, CSCP) Strong command of demand and production planning, scheduling, MRP, purchasing, inventory management and logistics Hands-on experience with ERP/MRP systems Strong analytical skills and ability to turn complex data into clear priorities and decisions Excellent communication and cross-functional coordination skills Thrives in a fast-changing, growing organization Fluent French and English Nice to have Experience in semiconductor, photonics, electronics or other high-tech manufacturing Foundries, outsourced manufacturing and long-lead-time, critical-component supply chains International suppliers and customers, customs and international logistics ERP implementation or supply chain digitalization; advanced Excel or Power BI Benefits Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience Profit-sharing & company savings plan 100% health coverage (Alan) 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000) What we offer: A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one A team eager to collaborate and grow with you A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely) Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between. Process Talent Acquisition Interview (45') Hiring Manager Interview (45') Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward) Meeting with the teams 2 reference check Offer (This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles) At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 At Quandela, we're scaling up the manufacturing of our semiconductor and photonic products, moving from low-volume technical production toward structured, scalable manufacturing. We're looking for a hands-on engineer who enjoys working close to production. At the interface between Process Engineering and Production, you'll turn qualified processes into simple, robust and practical production standards, making manufacturing easier to execute, easier to control, more repeatable and more efficient. Your Key Responsibilities Translate qualified processes into clear, executable production methods and define the optimal sequence of manufacturing operations Create and maintain manufacturing routings, Work Instructions, SOPs, checklists, inspection points and standard times, ensuring they reflect the approved process Define the resources required for each operation (equipment, tooling, materials, operator skills, inspection) and ensure consistency between BOM, routings, instructions and production data Support the setup and maintenance of manufacturing master data in ERP/MES systems Validate methods directly on the shop floor with operators, collect their feedback and integrate improvements into standards Train operators on new or modified methods and deploy standardized work and visual standards Analyze production flows to reduce non-value-added activities, waiting time, handling, excessive WIP and rework, and improve workstation organization, ergonomics and layout Measure and analyze machine, operator, setup and inspection times, compare actual vs. standard times, and provide reliable data for capacity planning, costing, workforce planning and investment decisions Identify, validate and document tooling and support workstation design Provide hands-on production support, investigate recurring issues related to methods, tooling or documentation, and implement practical corrective actions Support new product introduction and ramp-up, and manage the production impact of process, product or equipment changes Drive continuous improvement (5S, VSM, PDCA, 5 Why, or a related field Minimum 6 years of experience in manufacturing methods, production engineering or industrial engineering Proven experience creating Work Instructions, manufacturing routings and title: CDI - CREATIVE DESIGNER (H/F)
description: LA MAISON JACQUEMUS Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street). title: CDI - CHEF DE PRODUIT CHAINE ET TRAME HOMME (H/F)
description: LA MAISON JACQUEMUS Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8 ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai. VOTRE RÔLE Le/La Product Développer chaîne & trame homme est en charge du développement des catégories outerwear, tailleur, shirting, en lien les équipes design , dans le respect des objectifs de prix, de qualité et de délais. Le poste est sous la supervision du responsable développement C&T, Denim et Cuir Homme. VOS MISSIONS Produit : Suivre le développement des modèles chaîne & trame homme du brief à la normalisation Participer à la mise au point des produits (prototypes, essayages, validations) et garantir la qualité, le bien-aller et l’information. Coûts : Contribuer au respect des cibles prix et marge, en intégrant les contraintes industrielles dès le développement et en proposant des optimisations . Suivi & coordination : Piloter les échanges avec les façonniers, assurer le lien opérationnel avec le studio, l’atelier et la production, et garantir la bonne circulation de l’information. Suivre l’avancement des développements, anticiper les risques et veiller au respect des diffèrent jalons de développement. VOTRE PROFIL Expérience 2/3 ans sur la catégorie C&T. Maitrise Pack office, PLM serait un plus Capacité à suivre les développements dans un environnement créatif et exigeant. Rigueur, sens du détail, forte capacité d’adaptation. title: (Senior) Sales Manager (m/w/d) | Bonn
description: Über uns Die hairfree GmbH ist Marktführer für dauerhafte Haarentfernung¹ in der DACH-Region. Mit über 70 Standorten in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz sowie mehr als 100 Mitarbeitenden gehören wir zu den führenden Anbietern im Bereich ästhetischer Dienstleistungen. Seit über 20 Jahren verbinden wir professionelle Beratung, innovative Behandlungskonzepte und echte Leidenschaft für Beauty. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Interessentinnen und begleitest sie vom ersten Kontakt bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dabei geht es nicht nur um Beratung, sondern darum, Vertrauen aufzubauen, Bedürfnisse zu erkennen und unsere Kundinnen für die passende Behandlungslösung zu begeistern. Das Beste: Du arbeitest ausschließlich mit Hot-Leads. Das bedeutet, du erhältst täglich vorqualifizierte Anfragen von Menschen, die bereits Interesse an dauerhafter Haarentfernung¹ haben. Was dich bei uns erwartet Attraktives Grundgehalt plus ungedeckelte Provisionen Flexible Arbeitszeiten Hohe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (Coaching, Academy, interne Trainings) Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb des Unternehmens Mitarbeiter-Events & Teamkultur Moderne Arbeitsumgebung & gute Ausstattung Mitarbeiter-Rabatte / Vergünstigungen Flache Hierarchien & offene Kommunikation Klare Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten, zum Beispiel zur Teamleitung Wertschätzung, Teamgeist und gemeinsame Erfolgserlebnisse Gute Erreichbarkeit & Parkplätze Deine Aufgaben Du berätst warme Leads, die bereits Interesse an hairfree gezeigt haben, und baust durch eine empathische und überzeugende Kommunikation Vertrauen auf. Du erkennst die Wünsche und Bedürfnisse unserer Interessent*innen und führst sie professionell bis zur verbindlichen Terminbuchung. Du fasst offene Kontakte zuverlässig nach und stellst sicher, dass kein potenzieller Kunde verloren geht. Du übernimmst die vertriebliche Verantwortung für deinen Standort und entwickelst ihn gemeinsam mit deinem Team erfolgreich weiter. Du behältst Umsatzziele, Vertriebskennzahlen und die Auslastung des Standorts jederzeit im Blick und leitest passende Maßnahmen ab. Du unterstützt deine Mitarbeitenden im Vertriebsalltag, gibst regelmäßig Feedback und förderst ihre fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Du sorgst dafür, dass vereinbarte Vertriebsstandards eingehalten und Kundenanfragen schnell sowie verbindlich bearbeitet werden. Du dokumentierst Gespräche, Termine und relevante Kundeninformationen sorgfältig in unserem digitalen System. Du arbeitest eng mit der Vertriebsleitung und den anderen Standorten zusammen und bringst eigene Ideen ein, um Prozesse, Ergebnisse und die Kundenerfahrung kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Und das Beste: Du wirst Schritt für Schritt eingearbeitet und erhältst regelmäßige Trainings, damit du sicher, professionell und erfolgreich in deine Rolle hineinwächst. Du hast Freude am Kontakt mit Menschen und kannst durch deine offene, empathische Art schnell Vertrauen aufbauen. Du bringst Interesse an Beauty, Haut, Ästhetik und dauerhafter Haarentfernung¹ mit. Du arbeitest gerne vertriebsorientiert und hast Spaß daran, Kund*innen zu beraten, zu überzeugen und zum Abschluss zu begleiten. Du kommunizierst klar, professionell und wertschätzend – am Telefon, im persönlichen Gespräch und im Team. Du bist zuverlässig, gut organisiert und behältst auch bei mehreren Kontakten und Terminen den Überblick. Du arbeitest zielorientiert, motiviert und hast Lust, dich fachlich sowie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, in der Kundenberatung, im Beauty-Bereich, in der Kosmetik oder im Dienstleistungsumfeld ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Auch Quereinsteiger (m/w/d) mit Verkaufstalent und Begeisterung für Beauty sind herzlich willkommen. Warum hairfree? Klingt nach deiner nächsten Herausforderung? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen. Der Bewerbungsprozess ist bei uns unkompliziert und schnell, du musst kein langes Anschreiben vorbereiten, ein kurzer Lebenslauf reicht uns für den Start völlig aus. Wenn du Fragen zur Position oder zum Team hast, melde dich jederzeit gerne direkt bei uns. Wir geben dir offen und ehrlich einen Einblick in die Rolle und unser Projekt. title: Agentic Product Manager
description: About us: Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage. Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most. Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied. At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you. About the role: We’re looking for a hands-on and strategically minded Product Manager to take the reins of our assistant surfaces and agent harness at DeepJudge. You’ll play a critical role in shaping the present and future of our platform by driving immediate impact across our go-to-market priorities while also thinking deeply about where we go next. This is an opportunity to lead product in a high-caliber environment where you're empowered to innovate, move fast, and deliver real value to legal professionals at some of the most sophisticated law firms and legal departments in the world. This is an on-site role based in Zurich. You will report to the Head of Product. We’re not building another AI wrapper. We’re building a product with real depth, differentiated by data access, search engine expertise, and deep customer understanding. Chat is quickly becoming the interface of choice, and we’re now moving towards long-horizon agentic tasks – right at the cutting edge of what’s proven in the market. We’re looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is energized by the opportunity to create, and knows how to “cook from scratch” — not just follow the norm . Your responsibilities will include: Own product strategy, roadmap and execution across our Agentic Surfaces and Harness, powering DeepJudge’s advanced AI reasoning features, with a strong focus on prioritization, user impact, and business value Evolve our chat interface to make sure the user experience is the best fit for our target use cases Prioritize feature requests across customers, vertical product areas and new strategic initiatives, balancing short-term go-to-market optimization with long-term discovery and strategic vision Evolve our evaluation datasets and infrastructure to continuously improve our ability to take launch decisions with confidence Assess the speed, quality and cost profile of model or harness changes and drive decision-making across tech and product leadership Proactively identify new technologies and follow the latest agentic AI trends to drive efficiency and performance of complex, long-horizon tasks Work directly with engineering leads to define and ship high-quality features fast Collaborate with Design and Product Marketing to craft delightful and intuitive user experiences Engage deeply with customers and prospects to gather insights, validate ideas, and translate feedback into roadmap priorities – combining direct feedback with scaled usage analysis to understand how our products are used, and sharing those learnings title: Head of Crypto
description: About us Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance . That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in. What you'll be doing As the Head of Crypto, you will be the driving force behind a brand new, core pillar of Satispay's expansion into the cryptocurrency and Web3 space. We already have a high-potential strategy in place—your mission is to take the reins, execute it flawlessly, adapt it when necessary, and expand upon it wherever possible. Given the strategic importance of this initiative to Satispay, you will work with a high degree of autonomy and have direct, frequent touchpoints with the Satispay founding team to align on execution, team scaling, and long-term vision. Here’s what that looks like in practice: Hire & Build Your Team: Identify talent needs, recruit, and structure a dedicated, high-performing cross-functional team from the ground up to bring Satispay's crypto vertical to life. Execution & Strategic Evolution: Take ownership of our existing crypto roadmap. Drive its execution to deliver immediate impact, while continuously evaluating the market to make necessary adjustments and expand our offerings when new opportunities arise. Executive Collaboration: Partner directly with the founders and C-level executives to ensure the crypto rollout continuously aligns with the company's ultimate mission to simplify everyday finance. Product Development: Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of our crypto products—from infrastructure setup and go-to-market strategy to launch and continuous optimization. Regulatory Navigation: Work in lockstep with the Compliance and Legal teams to ensure all products align perfectly with evolving European regulations (such as MiCA) and safeguarding standards. Strategic Partnerships: Identify and establish crucial relationships with key players in the crypto ecosystem, including exchanges, custodians, liquidity providers, and blockchain networks. You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership. What we're looking for We are seeking for an execution-focused, and product-minded leader with a deep passion for digital assets that matches our company culture. Experience: 7+ years of experience in crypto/Web3 initiatives at a regulated Fintech, exchange, or crypto-native company. Team Building: experience hiring, managing, and scaling specialized, high-performing teams in a fast-paced tech or financial environment. Master of Execution: ability to take a high-level strategy and turn it into shipped products, scaling operations effectively from the ground up. Industry & Market Expertise: Deep, technical understanding of blockchain architecture, crypto market dynamics, digital wallets, custody solutions, and Web3 infrastructure. Regulatory Awareness: Solid knowledge of the European crypto regulatory landscape (e.g., MiCA, AML/KYC for digital assets) and a history of launching products within a strict compliance framework. Strategic Adaptability: Ability to balance bold expansion with stringent risk management Communication & Influence: Excellent ability to align internal and external stakeholders, translating complex crypto concepts into clear, actionable business updates for the founding team. Language Proficiency: You are completely fluent in English. Knowledge of Italian is considered a plus. We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement. Why this is your place This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impacts are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities. Drive transformative impact. Lead critical functions and initiatives that directly contribute to our mission and impact millions of users and businesses. Operate in high-growth. Thrive in a dynamic, fast-moving environment that demands bravery, resilience, and rapid, decisive action at scale. Experience the excitement of navigating growth where change is constant and the customer base/services are rapidly expanding. Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success. Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on. CareAbout: how we support your impact We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout: ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops. 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries. ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply. 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy, flexible working hours. 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness. Equal Opportunity Employer At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin. Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs! Learn more about us Curious what it's actually like here? description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Dubai, UAE</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Account Executive to join our <strong>Digital Natives</strong> team in Dubai. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned enterprise-level clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).</p> <p>As an Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.</li> <li><strong>Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding:</strong> Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.</li> <li><strong>Multi-Engagement Leadership:</strong> Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.</li> <li><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Negotiation & Closure:</strong> Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisor & Coach:</strong> Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.</li> <li><strong>Organizational Impact & Leadership:</strong> Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable markets).</li> <li><strong>Proven ability to deeply understand complex customer IT architectures</strong> and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description: IN SHORT Are you a versatile problem-solver who wants to write software that impacts the physical world? As a Full Stack Software Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will be at the core of our operations, building systems that touch everything from warehouse automation to customer-facing smart fridges. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES Take ownership of warehouse and supplier web apps used daily for inbound processing, picking, labeling, and inventory. Develop and maintain our internal back-office tool, including the backend and GraphQL API that runs menus, deliveries, inventory, and customer sites. Manage the service connecting automated picking lanes to the rest of the system to ensure uninterrupted warehouse operations. Maintain and update the Point of Sale Android app running on hundreds of fridges, managing the release process for the entire fleet. Integrate and support payment systems (Card, TWINT), our ERP, and other partner integrations. Participate in the on-call rotation to debug live issues directly alongside the operations team. Visit the warehouse on-site to test changes and gather feedback from the people actually using the software. Translate vague problems from non-technical colleagues into shipped solutions without needing them broken down first. Own production deployments, managing logs, alerts, and careful rollouts with clear rollback plans. Break down larger features, review other engineers' pull requests, and proactively maintain system health through upgrades, testing, and cleanup. YOUR PROFILE Proven production experience in at least one typed backend language (such as C#, Java, Kotlin, Go, or TypeScript) and one modern frontend framework. Track record of successfully owning software in production, including on-call duties, debugging from logs, and resolving live issues while users wait. Familiarity with or willingness to dive into C#, TypeScript, Android, and Kotlin. Prior exposure to hardware, IoT, edge devices, payments, logistics, retail operations, or Odoo environments is highly advantageous. Demonstrated ability to dive into unfamiliar tech stacks, learn quickly, and ship reliable code. Strong passion for collaborating directly with end-users, including warehouse and operations staff, rather than exclusively with other engineers. High degree of curiosity and a proactive mindset to take full ownership of problems from end to end. Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken); knowledge of German or French is a plus. Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food. Valid work permit or Swiss passport. OUR BENEFITS Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age. We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either German or English. ABOUT US FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality. With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;). FELFEL is a family business that was founded in 2013. Today, we take care of around 1000 locations in Switzerland, and have 150 employees across our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York. www.felfel.ch Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><div><span id="m_8220454926977230902gmail-docs-internal-guid-9a9f34f4-7fff-014a-c97c-98ca90610a47">Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. The Role As a Software Engineer intern on Robot Autonomy, you'll work on the software that runs on our legged security robots: how they perceive their surroundings, know where they are, and move through real customer sites on patrol. title: Global Head of AI Deployment & Partner Delivery
description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . Summary Dust is hiring a Head of AI Deployment & Partner Delivery to make high-impact Dust deployments repeatable at scale. When customers deploy Dust well, AI agents become part of how their teams work every day. Your job is to make that happen consistently, whether a deployment is led by Dust or by a trusted partner. You will lead our most complex customer deployments, turn what works, technically and organizationally, into clear playbooks, and build the partner delivery capacity that lets more customers succeed with Dust in 2027 and beyond. This is a player-coach leadership role. You will lead and grow Dust’s global AI Deployment team, stay directly involved in our most important deployments, and build the methods, standards, and partner network that allow delivery to scale without depending on you for every engagement. You will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering to connect what customers want to achieve with how deployments are planned, delivered, and measured. This is a chance to define how an AI-native company delivers transformation: what an exceptional deployment looks like, how value is measured, and how partners become delivery teams our customers trust. What you’ll do Lead and grow the global AI Deployment team Lead Dust’s existing global AI Deployment team and set its direction, priorities, and standards. Hire and develop deployment leaders and practitioners as customer demand grows. Shape roles, career paths, and coverage across regions, customer segments, and deployment types. Coach the team through complex customer situations and hold a consistently high bar for the work. Set up the operating rhythms, capacity planning, and reporting the function needs to scale. Define how Dust deployments are delivered Build one deployment method, from discovery through handoff, that Dust and partner teams can both follow to the same standard. Define which deployments Dust should lead, which a partner can deliver well, and how work moves between the two. Set clear entry and exit criteria and go-live readiness checks, and track delivery health: time to first value, go-live quality, and customer satisfaction. Run regular delivery reviews, spot at-risk engagements early, and bring the right Dust and partner people together quickly when a deployment is blocked. Turn lessons from each engagement into reusable playbooks, templates, and reference architectures, and recurring friction into clear input for Product and Engineering. Lead AI transformation with strategic customers Personally lead complex, high-priority, and first-of-their-kind deployments, from scoping to lasting adoption, bringing in Solutions Engineering, Product, and Engineering when complexity or risk calls for it. Help customer leaders define what AI transformation means for their organization: map how teams work today and identify the workflows where agents can create the most value. Align executives, IT, security, and business teams on goals, use cases, and success measures, with a baseline before launch and measured impact after. Design change programs for each deployment: executive sponsorship, communication plans, role-based enablement, and clear adoption milestones. Develop AI operators and champions inside customer teams, and help customers update ways of working, governance, and ownership so agents become part of how teams operate. Track adoption after launch, act quickly when teams aren’t changing how they work, and hand off to Customer Success with a clear picture of what comes next. Build a high-quality partner delivery network Work with Partnerships to assess partners’ delivery capability, technical depth, and customer readiness. Start with a small, carefully selected group of partner practitioners and grow capacity as quality is proven. Co-create onboarding, training, certification, and train-the-trainer programs so partners can develop their own Dust experts. Co-deliver early partner engagements, then help partners progress toward delivering independently, leading adoption, not just implementation. Ensure customers experience Dust and its partners as one aligned team, with clear responsibilities on every engagement. Requirements You have at least 6 years of experience leading and developing customer-facing deployment or delivery teams, ideally across multiple regions or customer segments and through periods of fast change. You have led complex enterprise deployments or transformation programs and delivered measurable customer outcomes. You have built or significantly improved a deployment methodology, professional services model, or delivery function, adding the structure needed to scale without unnecessary process. You have led organizational change alongside technology rollouts, and built champion networks or adoption plans that changed how teams work after the project ended. You don’t need to be a machine-learning engineer. Beyond that, we care more about evidence that you have built high-performing delivery systems than about a perfect sequence of titles. You understand how systems integrators, consultancies, and implementation partners staff, deliver, and grow a practice, and you have built enablement or certification programs that created lasting capability in teams you didn’t manage. You have turned around engagements at risk from scope, staffing, technical complexity, or stakeholder misalignment, and you know when to standardize, when to adapt, and when to reset. You are credible with customer executives, partner leaders, and technical practitioners, and you communicate clearly with all of them. You are a hands-on, low-ego leader with a builder’s instinct: you would rather solve the problem than hand off a recommendation. You are comfortable traveling to customers and partners when it matters most. AI and technical credibility Advise customers on where AI agents can create meaningful value and where they can’t yet, and explain why to technical teams, business leaders, and executives. Understand how agents work in practice: prompting, context, tool use, retrieval, evaluations, reliability, and cost. Challenge a deployment plan’s assumptions about integrations, data connectors, authentication, permissions, security, and production readiness, and discuss the trade-offs with engineers. Design evaluation approaches that connect AI performance to customer and business outcomes. Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Learn how we think and work. Our product constitution, a story about our mission Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human , Stanislas Polu , VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them. Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI , Gabriel Hubert , Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe. Confidence working across clinical and technical teams and with external partners. 📃 You are the right person if you have already Gained at least five years of relevant experience in Clinical Data Management and GCP compliance within a pharmaceutical company or CRO. title: Senior Security Engineer
description: 🏨 L'entreprise Resilience Care, acteur majeur de la télésurveillance médicale et partenaire de la recherche clinique, est une société française fondée en 2021 avec une mission : mieux soigner. Notre entreprise propose des solutions de télésurveillance en oncologie, gastro-entérologie et psychiatrie, basées sur la collecte d'ePRO associées à des techniques d'IA. Elles s'appuient sur une plateforme de suivi pour les professionnels de santé, permettant une détection précoce des effets secondaires pour une prise en charge continue et anticipée, et une application mobile pour les patients, permettant de mesurer et gérer leurs symptômes grâce à des ressources adaptées. Nos solutions permettent d'optimiser les prises en charge, d'enrichir la compréhension des patients en continu pendant leur parcours de soin et d'accélérer la recherche clinique grâce à la collecte, la structuration et l'analyse fine des données de vie réelle. Elles sont aujourd'hui déployées en routine auprès de 35 000 patients, dans plus de 200 établissements de santé, mais également dans le cadre d'une vingtaine d'études cliniques académiques et industrielles. Nous mettons ainsi la donnée au service du soin et de l'innovation thérapeutique avec l'ambition de permettre à chaque patient de bénéficier d'une médecine personnalisée. 📝 Ton rôle En quelques mots : tu incarnes la sécurité au quotidien auprès de toutes les équipes, en binôme avec notre Security Engineer. Ton terrain principal, c'est le produit : comprendre ce qu'on construit, analyser les risques au plus tôt, négocier ce qui doit l'être à l'intérieur des fonctionnalités, et faire aboutir les corrections avec ceux qui écrivent le code. Ton impact : nos solutions sont utilisées en routine dans plus de 200 établissements de santé. La sécurité n'y est pas un sujet théorique : elle conditionne la confiance des soignants et la protection des données de patients. description: Introduction The selected person will join the Technopolis Group Data Science Unit (DSU), whose members work across different country offices. Our growing team brings together diverse academic backgrounds and a shared passion for developing data science applications to improve policymaking. The DSU contributes to policy consulting projects and conducts R&D to develop and test new applications, sometimes in collaboration with internal and external partners. Its work includes record linkage, classification, natural language processing, web scraping, generative AI and dynamic visualisations. As an intern, you will work alongside experienced data scientists and policy consultants, applying and developing your technical skills to address real-world policy questions. About this job The role of the intern in data science for public policy will be to support the data science components of policy evaluations , sectoral studies and strategic consultancy projects. Our clients include French regional councils, the French Development Agency (AFD), ADEME, the European Commission and multilateral development banks. You will be part of the DSU and collaborate with colleagues across policy areas, including science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition, international cooperation and health. You may also contribute to internal R&D and business development activities, particularly the preparation of data science approaches for project proposals. No previous professional experience is required. Relevant coursework, academic research and personal coding projects will be considered. We are looking to recruit a full-time intern for at least 6 months starting in Automn 2026 . Internship should be sponsored by the intern’s university (stage conventionné). Your profile We are looking for a curious and motivated individual who enjoys working with data and wants to understand how data science can inform public policy. Suitable candidates should have: Master’s-level studies in data science, computer science, statistics, economics, engineering or another relevant discipline with a strong quantitative component, and be eligible for a university-sponsored internship. Practical programming skills in Python, demonstrated through coursework, research or personal projects, and the ability to write and understand their own analytical code. Good foundations in statistics and quantitative analysis, together with an interest in economics and public policy and in interpreting analytical results in their policy context. Basic familiarity with machine learning or natural language processing, and an interest in using generative AI and large language models programmatically through APIs for data processing, text analysis and knowledge extraction. A careful and structured approach to working with data, including attention to data quality, validation, documentation and reproducibility. An interest in public policy and in using data science to support evidence-based policymaking , particularly in areas such as science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition or health policy. Fluency in French and English, good communication skills and an ability to work collaboratively in an international and multicultural environment. A third language would be an asset. Your responsibilities Working under the guidance of experienced colleagues, you will: Support the design and implementation of data science analyses to answer policy questions, writing code in Python. Collect, clean, link and validate data from multiple sources, including open datasets, databases and web-based sources. Help develop and test analytical workflows, potentially involving machine learning, NLP and LLM APIs for classification, text analysis and knowledge extraction. Contribute to indicators, scoreboards and visualisations, including dashboards where relevant, to make findings accessible to different audiences. Interpret and communicate results, helping prepare reports, methodological documentation and presentations for clients. Contribute to the DSU’s R&D and proposal preparation, for example by exploring new datasets, testing methods or developing small prototypes. description: <p><a href="https://docs.datadoghq.com/tracing/">Application Performance Monitoring</a> (APM) is one of Datadog’s premier products that helps developers see inside complex distributed systems. You’ll work with language experts to deliver cutting-edge observability products across our 9 supported languages, with industry leading performance and a world class developer experience. You’ll rethink our SDKs’ architecture, APIs, data models, and protocol to meet Datadog’s current needs and scale, all while building in the open. And you’ll grow your team’s capacity by fostering a culture focused on customer needs, continuous learning, and innovation. </p> <p>We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager who cares as much about technical excellence as empowering other engineering teams. </p> <p><em>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Toronto, Ontatio</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Department</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.  Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. </span></p> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">You'll drive new business by identifying and qualifying target commercial accounts in Ontario for Cloudflare’s Enterprise service plan. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon, or London (Hybrid)</strong></h3> <div class="container"> <div id="model-response-message-contentr_ccb59069932b9a6f" class="markdown markdown-main-panel md-content enable-luminous-fast-follows enable-updated-hr-color stronger tutor-markdown-rendering"> <h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>We build the products that enable the next era of the Internet: making domains <strong>Readable</strong>, <strong>Discoverable</strong>, and <strong>Callable</strong> for autonomous AI agents.</p> <p>Here at Cloudflare, agentic discovery is a core part of our vision for the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/the-agentic-internet/">Agentic Internet</a>. As AI agents change how humans and machines find, evaluate, and act on information, businesses need tools to control how they are represented and reached. We build capabilities that enable website owners to prepare their sites for agent interaction, test and observe how agents read their content, establish open interaction standards (like WebMCP and MCP), and create entirely new channels to reach agentic audiences.</p> <p>We are a cross functional group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to serve as a technical anchor and become a subject matter expert on our Agentic Discovery team. In this role, you will define the architecture, core protocols, and multi-team standards powering the next generation of agent-web interactions.</p> <p>As a senior technical leader, you will shape product roadmaps, mentor engineers across Cloudflare, and write technical specifications that drive execution across multiple teams. You will drive engineering excellence across edge infrastructure, data pipelines, protocol layers, and developer tooling, ensuring systems are resilient and complexity is reduced for your peers.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Architect and ship high-throughput, resilient production services </strong>that make web properties Readable (structured content transformation), Discoverable (indexing and AEO), and Callable (WebMCP, tool-calling APIs, Generative UI) for autonomous agents.</li> <li><strong>Define emerging agent protocols and integrations</strong> (MCP, MCP Apps, UCP, MPP, WebMCP). stakeholders</strong> to translate customer needs into technical requirements, clarify KPIs, and shape engineering roadmaps.</li> <li><strong>Drive improvements in system health and observability. engineering process across Cloudflare</strong> through code reviews, technical mentorship, architectural governance, and candidate evaluation for engineering hiring.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, multi-service architectures.</li> <li>Hands-on experience and deep conceptual understanding of AI agents, tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or agent harnesses.</li> <li>Ability to partner with product managers and customers to navigate ambiguous problem spaces and iteratively deliver large-scale architecture.</li> <li>Experience mentoring junior and mid-level engineers, contributing to hiring, and driving improvements to engineering processes and incident response workflows.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Fluency in async Rust or TypeScript/JavaScript edge runtimes (e.g., description: Location: Hybrid, Zürich (2-3 days in office) About what. AG We're a Zurich-based digital consultancy with 40+ ambitious, kind specialists. We build websites, digital products and growth strategies powered by data and AI, for clients from innovative startups to global brands. Learn more at what.digital . The role: You take a business-first, data-driven view of what's holding a client's growth back, use AI to diagnose it faster and deeper than a traditional audit, and turn it into a concrete plan that works. It's a long-term role with variety, autonomy, support and a clear path to grow. How we work: You own your growth, and we give you the space to work on yourself. We deliver first-class help to our clients, from start to finish. We focus on real results, not just activity. And we think like entrepreneurs: when we build for clients, everyone wins - our clients, what. and you. What you'll do: Be the main point of contact for your clients and build long-term relationships - you think about their business, not just their campaigns. Implement growth strategies across SEO/GEO, paid ads, email, social and more, using AI with the team. Coordinate specialists to deliver great work on time and on budget, with high standards and honest feedback.
